papers.summary_en: A sim-trained LEAP pose-reaching policy uses diverse grasp resets and friction curricula, with an adjustable learned residual safety filter.
papers.summary_zh: 仿真训练LEAP手内位姿到达策略，采用多样抓取重置与摩擦课程，并叠加可调学习式残差安全滤波器。

papers.title: Bridging Exploration and Loss of Plasticity in On-Policy Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary_en: Analysis links collapsing Gaussian exploration variance in PPO to sharp/low-rank loss geometry and loss of plasticity; resetting variance helps adaptation.
papers.summary_zh: 分析将PPO高斯探索方差塌缩与尖锐/低秩损失几何及可塑性丧失联系，并用方差重置改善适应。

papers.title: GRAFT: Geometry-Aware Residual Adaptation for Foundation Trackers
papers.summary_en: Geometry-aware residual adaptation preserves frozen whole-body foundation trackers while learning terrain execution, then distills privileged terrain observations into an onboard-depth adapter.
papers.summary_zh: 几何感知残差适应保持全身基础跟踪器冻结，学习地形执行，再将特权地形观测蒸馏为机载深度适配器。

papers.title: Skill Dreaming: Evolving Repository Skills through Pull Request Streams
papers.summary_en: Skill Dreaming evolves repository skills from validated pull-request streams, including alignment of stale or conflicting instructions.
papers.summary_zh: Skill Dreaming 从已验证 PR 流中演化仓库技能，并对陈旧或冲突指令进行对齐。

papers.title: When Retrieval Is Not Enough: Obsolete Facts in Agent Memory
papers.summary_en: Separates retrieval coverage from stale-fact interference when an agent must use updated memory.
papers.summary_zh: 将检索到最新事实与生成阶段受过时事实干扰这两个问题分开检验。

papers.title: When the Critic Falls Behind: Co-Evolving Rubrics and Harnesses for Continual Agent Self-Improvement
papers.summary_en: RuHarness co-evolves diagnostic rubrics and executable harnesses while keeping the task objective fixed.
papers.summary_zh: RuHarness 在固定任务目标下共同演化诊断 rubric 与可执行 harness。

papers.title: Does Your Generalist Skill Optimizer Really Incentivize Agentic Tasks? Rethinking Skill Optimization via Bipartite Attribution
papers.summary_en: BiPA audits skill optimizers using unchanged-candidate selection controls and bipartite attribution of context costs.
papers.summary_zh: BiPA 用不编辑候选的选择对照及二部图上下文成本归因，审计技能优化器。

papers.title: Context Is a Pipeline, Not a Window: Information Attrition in LLM Agent Harnesses
papers.summary_en: Models information loss across an agent harness pipeline rather than treating nominal context-window length as usable evidence.
papers.summary_zh: 将 agent harness 的信息损失拆为处理流水线，而非把上下文窗口长度等同于可用证据量。

papers.title: Adapting Video Models for Robot Control via Motion-guided Asymmetric Prediction
papers.summary_en: MoGAP adds training-only asymmetric motion-guided noise prediction to video world models without an external teacher or extra inference branch.
papers.summary_zh: MoGAP 为视频世界模型增加仅训练时使用的运动引导非对称噪声预测，不引入外部教师或额外推理分支。

papers.title: Select-TTT: Query-Conditioned Selective Fast Weight Updates for In-Place Test-Time Training
papers.summary_en: Select-TTT uses the frozen language-model head to score query relevance and reweight in-place fast-weight updates without adding parameters.
papers.summary_zh: Select-TTT 用冻结语言模型输出头评估查询相关性，重加权原位 fast-weight 更新，不增加参数。

papers.title: Understanding the limits of latent world models
papers.summary_en: Separates faithful dynamics from reward attainment using latent rollout consistency and dynamics equivariance.
papers.summary_zh: 以潜空间 rollout 一致性及动力学等变性区分动力学忠实度与任务回报。

papers.title: CoHARL: Co-Evolving Agent Policies and Executable Harnesses with Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary_en: CoHARL jointly trains one shared policy and evolves a population of executable harnesses under fixed evaluators and action families.
papers.summary_zh: CoHARL 在固定评估器和动作族下共同训练共享策略并演化可执行 harness 种群。

papers.title: Your Policy Is Secretly a Harness: The Decision Geometry of Agent Interfaces
papers.summary_en: Studies how an agent interface changes both its attainable return and the mismatch of an already trained policy.
papers.summary_zh: 研究 agent 接口如何同时改变可达回报上界与既有策略的不匹配程度。

papers.title: Evaluation-Guided Demonstration Refinement for Vision-Language-Action Policies: The Winning Entry in the MetaFine Open Competition
papers.summary_en: Task-specific pi0.5 policies combine nominal demonstrations, expert corrections from policy states, and evaluation-guided demonstration refinement.
papers.summary_zh: 任务专用 pi0.5 策略结合常规示范、策略状态上的专家纠正，以及评测驱动的示范细化。

papers.title: OmniBrain-0: A Unified Agentic Model for Embodied Intelligence
papers.summary_en: OmniBrain-0 consolidates expert agent trajectories into one high-level model with on-policy distillation and rubric-guided self-improvement, retaining specialist low-level skills.
papers.summary_zh: OmniBrain-0 以 on-policy 蒸馏和 rubric 引导自改进将专家 agent 轨迹整合为统一高层模型，仍保留专用低层技能。

papers.title: Experience Memory Graph: Extracting Reusable Correction Knowledge from Agent Trajectories
papers.summary_en: v3 substantially rewrites Experience Memory Graph around reusable correction knowledge extracted by aligning failed exploration and expert-success trajectories.
papers.summary_zh: v3 大幅重写 Experience Memory Graph，以失败探索与专家成功轨迹对齐来提取可复用纠正知识。

papers.title: MemPrism: Task-Conditioned Relational Memory Views for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.summary_en: v2 substantially revises MemPrism: a persistent event store is separated from temporary task-conditioned relational memory views.
papers.summary_zh: v2 实质修订 MemPrism：将持久事件存储与任务条件化的临时关系记忆视图分离。

papers.title: Seeing the Options: What Should a Visual Candidate See?
papers.summary_en: Seeing the Options separates request-conditioned candidate encoding from candidate-to-candidate interaction in visual decisions.
papers.summary_zh: Seeing the Options区分视觉决策中的请求条件候选编码与候选间交互。

papers.title: What Makes Video World Model Latents Action-Relevant: Prediction over Reconstruction
papers.summary_en: v2 adds action-shuffled and forward-dynamics controls across all 26 held-out LIBERO tasks to study action relevance beyond reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh: v2 在全部 26 个留出 LIBERO 任务增加动作打乱和前向动力学对照，检验重建之外的动作相关性。

papers.title: MemWM: Associative Memory-Enhanced Latent World Models for Long-Horizon Planning
papers.summary_en: Adds a content-addressable memory bank and slot-diversity objectives to a JEPA-style latent world model for planning.
papers.summary_zh: 在 JEPA 式潜世界模型中加入内容寻址记忆库与槽位多样性目标，用于规划。

papers.title: VisCurate: Evaluating Behavioral Equivalence of Visual Skills
papers.summary_en: VisCurate v2 strengthens protocol disclosure for visual skill-library curation, including disjoint calibration and sandbox admission of edits.
papers.summary_zh: VisCurate v2 加强视觉技能库整理的协议披露，包括不相交校准与编辑的沙箱准入。

papers.title: Vision-Language Agents Can Learn in Their Own Latent Worlds
papers.summary_en: Latent world-model policy improvement within a frozen VLM; simulated interactive-agent evidence.
papers.summary_zh: 冻结VLM内部的潜在世界模型策略改进，证据来自仿真交互Agent。

papers.title: The Trinity:Capability-Driven Recursive Self-Improvement for Multimodal Agents
papers.summary_en: Capability-organized harness evolution with CaP-X/SOON robot transfer; configuration-level, small-sample evidence.
papers.summary_zh: 按能力组织Harness演化并迁移到CaP-X/SOON真机；证据是小样本整套配置比较。

papers.title: SO-101 Bench: Accessible Spatial Manipulation
papers.summary_en: A low-cost-arm benchmark directly tests code-agent/VLA complementarity under controlled adaptation budgets and real-robot ranking checks.
papers.summary_zh: 低成本臂基准在控制适配预算并核对真机排序的条件下，直接检验代码Agent与VLA的互补作用。

papers.title: LabWorld: Learning Interactive 4D Worlds for Scientific Experimentation
papers.summary_en: Event-conditioned laboratory reconstruction exposes the mismatch between image agreement and modeled interaction validity, without downstream robot validation.
papers.summary_zh: 事件条件实验室重建揭示图像一致性与所建模交互有效性的差异，尚无下游机器人验证。

papers.title: TS-DP: Reinforcement Speculative Decoding For Temporal Adaptive Diffusion Policy Acceleration
papers.summary_en: Substantive v2 adds real-time manipulation and fidelity evidence, with NFE accounting explicitly separated from wall-clock speed.
papers.summary_zh: 实质性v2新增实时操作与保真证据，并明确区分NFE计量和实测时延。

papers.title: Learning to Feel the Future: DreamTacVLA for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.summary_en: v4→v5 clarifies that a lightweight action-conditioned forecasting MLP predicts tactile latents while the pretrained tactile world model stays frozen; it adds capacity/data scaling and an explicit limitations section.
papers.summary_zh: v4→v5明确由轻量动作条件MLP预测触觉潜变量、预训练触觉世界模型保持冻结，并补充模型/数据扩展与局限分析。

papers.title: DeFM: Learning Foundation Representations from Depth for Robotics
papers.summary_en: v2→v3 revises depth-encoder segmentation probe tables and makes the hyperparameter protocol explicit rather than introducing a new robot-control result.
papers.summary_zh: v2→v3修订深度编码器分割探针表，并明确超参数协议；不是新增机器人控制结果。

papers.title: RePO-VLA: Recovery-Driven Policy Optimization for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.summary_en: v1→v2 expands recovery-data causal-confusion analysis, matched-budget value-supervision controls, and blinded real-robot perturbation protocols.
papers.summary_zh: v1→v2扩充恢复数据因果混淆分析、等预算价值监督对照，以及真机盲测扰动协议。

papers.title: Grasp-Then-Plan with Failure Attribution: A Closed Two-Stage Framework for Precise and Generalizable Robotic Manipulation
papers.summary_en: v1→v2 strengthens failure-attribution audits, matched data-budget controls, threshold sensitivity, and the boundary between operational responsibility and physical causality.
papers.summary_zh: v1→v2补充失败归因审计、等数据预算对照和阈值敏感性，明确操作责任与物理因果并不等价。

papers.title: FAWAM: Force-Aware World Action Models for Closed-Loop Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.summary_en: v2→v3 adds residual-correction baselines under matched intervention budgets and clarifies the no-prediction residual ablation.
papers.summary_zh: v2→v3加入匹配人工干预预算的残差修正基线，并澄清无预测残差消融。

papers.title: FTP-1: A Generalist Foundation Tactile Policy Across Tactile Sensors for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.summary_en: v3→v4 specifies the 22-joint Sharpa-to-32-slot action mapping and adds tactile-feature probes and joint data/compute scaling experiments.
papers.summary_zh: v3→v4明确Sharpa的22关节到32槽位动作映射，并补充触觉特征探针及数据/算力共同扩展实验。

papers.title: From Grasps to Dexterity: Large-Scale Grasp Pretraining for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.summary_en: v1→v2 adds UniDex-VLA/Dex1B comparisons, synthesized-trajectory amount/composition ablations, an oracle-subgoal comparison, and explicit Shadow-to-LEAP adaptation details.
papers.summary_zh: v1→v2增加UniDex-VLA/Dex1B对照、合成轨迹规模/组成消融、oracle子目标对照及Shadow到LEAP适配细节。

papers.title: When Does Test-Time Physical Diagnosis Pay?
papers.summary_en: v1→v2 changes the diagnosis of transfer failure: full-trace deployment inputs lie outside the frozen decoder’s training range and collapse its responses.
papers.summary_zh: v1→v2重新定位迁移失败原因：完整轨迹部署输入超出冻结解码器训练范围，使其输出塌缩为常数答案。

papers.title: When Do Discrete Actions Make Good Continuous Controllers?
papers.summary_en: v1→v2 sharpens the interpretation of alternative action tokenizers by comparing complete operating points and distinguishing guided from unguided discrete regression.
papers.summary_zh: v1→v2按完整运行配置重新解释动作tokenizer结果，并区分有引导与无引导离散回归。

papers.title: BiDex-100: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation Across 100+ Simulation Tasks
papers.summary_en: v1→v2 corrects the dataset description by removing the claim of serialized initial states for exact reset replay and highlights ranking reversals across domains and metrics.
papers.summary_zh: v1→v2删去数据含可精确重置初始状态的声明，并强调跨域及不同指标的排名翻转。

papers.title: Semantic World Models
papers.summary_en: v1→v2 adds no-base-policy planning, question phrasing/weighting ablations, VLM-generated supervision checks, task decomposition, and explicit planning-cost measurements.
papers.summary_zh: v1→v2新增无基础策略规划、问题措辞/权重消融、VLM生成监督验证、任务分解及明确规划成本测量。

papers.title: AWARE: Action-Entropy-Weighted and Attention-Guided Retrieval of Observation Evidence for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.summary_en: v2→v3 replaces coarse uncertainty gating with element-wise entropy/depth-weighted observation retrieval and adds diagnostic alternatives and expanded matched-checkpoint evaluation.
papers.summary_zh: v2→v3以逐动作元素熵/深度加权观测检索替代粗粒度门控，补充诊断替代方案及匹配checkpoint评估。

papers.title: GARV: Graph-Aware Refinement and Safety Verification for High-Level Robot Plans
papers.summary_en: v1→v2 extends a hidden-path hazard audit into route-set certification and minimum-cost safe refinement with graph-grounded action contracts.
papers.summary_zh: v1→v2从隐藏路径风险审计扩展为基于图动作契约的路径集合认证及最小成本安全细化。

papers.title: Where Small Mistakes Matter: Quantifying State Criticality for Imitation Learning
papers.summary_en: v1→v2 adds the performance-gap derivation and implementation-level definitions for state-criticality baselines and real-robot adversarial residual learning.
papers.summary_zh: v1→v2补充性能差距推导、状态关键性基线定义及真机对抗残差学习实现细节。

papers.title: METATRON: A Promptable Whole-Body Execution Layer for Humanoids
papers.summary_en: METATRON separates a frozen generative whole-body controller from stateful programs that express task goals as prompts; coding agents refine those programs rather than retrain the motor policy.
papers.summary_zh: METATRON将冻结的生成式全身控制器与表达任务目标的有状态程序分离；编码智能体改进程序，而非重训运动策略。

papers.title: SkillCT: A Multidimensional Benchmark and Execution-Free Baseline for Agent Skill Assessment
papers.summary_en: Assesses nine dimensions of skill quality and predicts unseen-skill profiles by retrieving reference skills.
papers.summary_zh: 用九个维度评估技能质量，并检索参考技能预测新技能质量。

papers.title: ParaTTT: Parallelizing Test-Time Training Layers with Deep Memories
papers.summary_en: Parallelizes nonlinear neural memories by iterative refinement of the online gradient trajectory.
papers.summary_zh: 通过迭代细化在线梯度轨迹，并行计算非线性神经记忆。

papers.title: Recursive Self-Improvement in Physical AI: Mechanisms, Evidence, and Evaluation
papers.summary_en: This survey distinguishes improving a learner from inheriting a revised improvement process. Its L0–L3 rubric separates task-local adaptation, persistent capability, inherited process revisions and verified improver gains.
papers.summary_zh: 综述区分学习者能力改善与继承改进流程；L0–L3框架分别对应任务内适配、持久能力、流程修订继承及验证过的改进器收益。

papers.title: CSO: Refining Robotic Policies via Skill Distribution Alignment and Skill-Grained Optimization
papers.summary_en: CSO post-trains discrete-skill policies in two stages: align skill distributions with successful online trajectories, then optimize skill-level clipped ratios with the observation encoder frozen.
papers.summary_zh: CSO两阶段后训练离散技能策略：先用成功在线轨迹对齐技能分布，再冻结观察编码器进行技能粒度裁剪比率优化。

papers.title: ELEVATE: Agentic Controller Acquisition from Task Failure for Quadrupedal Manipulation
papers.summary_en: ELEVATE responds to persistent task-program failure by asking a coding agent to train missing controllers, validate them and add reusable skills. This expands the available action repertoire instead of endlessly replanning over fixed tools.
papers.summary_zh: ELEVATE在任务程序持续失败后让编码智能体训练缺失控制器、验证并加入技能库，扩展动作能力而非在固定工具上反复规划。

papers.title: When "No Worries" Went Wrong: HRI Lessons for Foundation-Model Robots
papers.summary_en: Engineering incidents show that plausible robot language can become socially wrong through timing or stale purpose. TRACE follows changed premises through evidence, authority and execution boundaries.
papers.summary_zh: 工程事故显示机器人言语即使合理，也会因时序或目的过期而失当；TRACE追踪变化前提如何经过证据、权限与执行边界。

papers.title: AtomTree: A Hierarchical Framework for State-Aware Embodied Instruction Following with LLMs
papers.summary_en: AtomTree incrementally decomposes subgoal trees using current symbolic state, stores concise outcome memory and backtracks to regenerate failed subtrees.
papers.summary_zh: AtomTree依据当前符号状态逐步分解子目标树，保存简洁结果记忆，并回溯重建失败子树。

papers.title: Context Compaction for World Models
papers.summary_en: Treats world consistency as a context-retrieval problem and compacts context at the agent-harness layer.
papers.summary_zh: 将世界一致性视为上下文检索问题，在 agent harness 层压缩上下文。

papers.title: Tracking Task Progress Through Errors and Recovery:A Benchmark and Recurrent Distributional Model
papers.summary_en: ReSTEP captures error and recovery trajectories; REMORA combines recurrent memory with a distribution over progress to avoid both jitter and falsely monotonic progress.
papers.summary_zh: ReSTEP记录错误与恢复轨迹；REMORA结合循环记忆与进度分布，减少抖动及错误的单调进度假设。

papers.title: VEvo-Harness: Causally-Guarded Self-Evolving Harness for Agentic Image Generation
papers.summary_en: Frozen generators are surrounded by persistent repair memory and skill patches admitted through paired counterfactual replay.
papers.summary_zh: 冻结生成器外围加入持久修复记忆，通过成对反事实回放决定技能补丁是否入库。

papers.title: EgoContact: Evaluating Physical Intelligence with Egocentric Video
papers.summary_en: EgoContact tests whether manipulation priors identify precise future contact locations in egocentric video, then reuses those examples as an affordance memory bank.
papers.summary_zh: EgoContact评测第一视角操作先验能否定位精确未来接触点，再将实例作为可供性记忆库。

papers.title: EmbodiExp: Compositional Experience Transfer for Embodied Agents
papers.summary_en: EmbodiExp represents experience as a subgoal with applicability conditions, an adaptable policy and a verifiable outcome, allowing local successes from failed trajectories to compose across tasks.
papers.summary_zh: EmbodiExp把经验表示为子目标、适用条件、可适配策略及可验证结果，可从失败轨迹保留局部成功并跨任务组合。

papers.title: Cross-Controller Transfer via In-Context Behavior Adaptation
papers.summary_en: Cross-controller transfer conditions π0.5 on commanded-versus-achieved interaction histories, allowing strategy changes rather than merely remapping motor commands.
papers.summary_zh: 跨控制器迁移把命令—实际运动历史作为π0.5上下文，使其改变策略而非仅重映射电机命令。

papers.title: ProLoop: Progress-Aware Closed-Loop Framework via Structured State Relations for Long-Horizon Robotic Task Planning
papers.summary_en: ProLoop makes subgoal progress explicit by comparing structured desired and observed states, then gates correction, continuation and memory retention on that relation.
papers.summary_zh: ProLoop比较结构化目标与观察状态，显式判断子目标进度，再决定继续、纠正及记忆保留。

papers.title: Before the Next Rollout: Diagnosing Skill Utility Shifts from Policy Updates
papers.summary_en: Uses policy-change readouts on saved contexts to prioritize skills whose utility is declining.
papers.summary_zh: 在已有上下文上读取策略变化，优先修订效用下降的技能。

papers.title: ScheduleGen: Demonstration Generation via Skill Scheduling for Multi-Arm Imitation Learning
papers.summary_en: ScheduleGen combines task planning and skill scheduling to synthesize demonstrations that respect multi-arm constraints, rather than independently replaying single-arm motions.
papers.summary_zh: ScheduleGen 将任务规划与技能调度结合，合成符合多臂约束的示范，而非独立重放单臂轨迹。

papers.title: Ask to Evolve: A Unified Harness for Lifelong Embodied Navigation with Hybrid Action Space and Persistent Memory
papers.summary_en: EvoLife is a navigation agent harness integrating geometric/pixel/object actions, active help-seeking, and persistent place records linking poses, images and dialogue. Its lifelong component is experience storage and retrieval, not demonstrated continual weight learning.
papers.summary_zh: EvoLife 把几何、像素和物体导航工具、主动求助与持久地点记忆整合到代理框架；地点记录绑定位姿、图像和对话。这里的终身能力主要是经验存取，并非持续更新模型权重。

papers.title: Teaching a Tree to Recover: Online Distillation of an LLM Supervisor with Counterfactual Replay
papers.summary_en: An LLM recovery supervisor is distilled online into a decision tree; counterfactual episode replays identify unnecessary or harmful interventions and retire corresponding rules. The learned tree replaces repeated runtime LLM calls on familiar states.
papers.summary_zh: 将 LLM 恢复监督器在线蒸馏为决策树，利用回合反事实重放识别多余或有害干预并淘汰规则，使熟悉状态无需反复调用 LLM。

papers.title: Surrogate Uncertainty for Black-box Visual Grounding
papers.summary_en: An external Bayesian surrogate estimates uncertainty for black-box VLM grounding rather than trusting the same model to grade itself. It uses multimodal calibration-neighborhood retrieval and can support conformal prediction or information-gathering planning.
papers.summary_zh: 通过外部贝叶斯代理估计黑盒 VLM 视觉定位不确定性，避免完全依赖原模型自评；以多模态校准邻域检索支持保形预测和主动信息收集。

papers.title: GROME: GROunding Factorized MEmory into Video World Models
papers.summary_en: Separates static geometry from dynamic entities, retrieves local evidence, and injects memory into a frozen video world model.
papers.summary_zh: 分离静态几何和动态实体，检索局部证据，并向冻结视频世界模型注入记忆。

papers.title: LOGIV: Graph-Verified Execution with Causal Local Repair for Long-Horizon Robot Tasks
papers.summary_en: LOGIV adds an explicit condition-support/resource-order graph above existing policies. It checks whether earlier effects remain valid, traces failed dependencies, and symbolically validates local repair together with the retained unfinished plan.
papers.summary_zh: LOGIV 在现有策略之上加入条件支撑与资源顺序图，持续检查先前动作效果是否仍成立，追踪失效依赖，并联合验证局部修复与保留的未完成计划。

papers.title: VideoMemBench: How Well Do MLLMs Remember in Video Conversations?
papers.summary_en: Tests dependencies on earlier visual episodes and the model's own prior answers across video conversations.
papers.summary_zh: 测试视频多轮对话对早期视觉事件和模型先前回答的依赖。

papers.title: Video Generation Meets Agent Harness: Agentic Video Generation, Agentic World Modeling and Recursive Self-Improvement
papers.summary_en: A report organizes agentic video systems around runtime state, tools, feedback, budgets, and distinct levels of self-improvement.
papers.summary_zh: 报告以运行时状态、工具、反馈和预算组织视频智能体，并区分不同层次的自我改进。

papers.title: RoboAtom: Large-scale Atomic-Action Supervision for Robot Learning
papers.summary_en: RoboAtom standardizes time-aligned atomic-action labels across existing robot datasets, combining manual annotation, propagation across repeated skill orders and quality control. It couples a skill-recognition benchmark with hierarchical policy training.
papers.summary_zh: RoboAtom 跨机器人数据集统一时间对齐的原子动作标签，结合人工标注、重复技能序列传播与质控，并提供技能识别基准及分层策略训练。

papers.title: LLM-guided Planar Loco-Manipulation for Quadruped Robots
papers.summary_en: A LoRA-trained language planner selects skills, objects and geometric targets from structured scene state, while RL controllers execute quadruped pushing and locomotion.
papers.summary_zh: LoRA 语言规划器根据结构化场景选择技能、物体和几何目标，由 RL 控制器执行四足推物和移动。

papers.title: RFW-A: Agentic Procedural Generation of 400K Articulated Assets over 500 Categories
papers.summary_en: Agents build reusable category-level articulated generators instead of reasoning separately for every asset.
papers.summary_zh: 以智能体构建可复用类别生成器，避免逐资产重复推理。

papers.title: JEDI: Joint-Embedding Demonstration Compression for In-Context Imitation Learning
papers.summary_en: JEDI compresses demonstrations into latent slots trained to predict query-stage futures in frozen video-JEPA space. Counterfactual task/process supervision preserves execution details and a predictor selects context from a demonstration bank.
papers.summary_zh: JEDI 将示范压缩为潜在槽，用冻结 video-JEPA 空间中的查询阶段未来预测进行训练；任务/过程反事实监督保留执行细节，并从示范库选择上下文。

papers.title: Prefix Executability: Evaluating Tool-Using Agents Beyond Final Success
papers.summary_en: Measures whether every tool-call prefix is executable, distinguishing final success from recovery after invalid actions.
papers.summary_zh: 逐步检查工具调用前缀是否可执行，将最终成功与出错后恢复区分开。

papers.title: DAWN: Diffusion-based Alignment and unfastening Workflow Network
papers.summary_en: DAWN decomposes robotic unscrewing into diffusion-based alignment/insertion, multimodal transition detection and force-controlled unfastening.
papers.summary_zh: DAWN 将机器人拆螺丝分为扩散策略对齐插入、多模态阶段切换检测和力控拆卸。

papers.title: PhysVLMM: Interaction-Conditioned Physical Belief Maps for Articulated Objects in Robot Scene Maps
papers.summary_en: PhysVLMM attaches uncertainty-aware physical beliefs to articulated scene-map parts, updates them from measured pulls, transfers evidence to similar untested parts and answers risk-bounded action queries or abstains.
papers.summary_zh: PhysVLMM 为场景图中关节部件维护不确定物理信念，用实测拉动更新，将证据传给相似未测部件，并对风险约束动作查询作答或弃权。

papers.title: Retrieval as Traversal: Value-Indexed Memory for Stateful Long-Context Agents
papers.summary_en: Proposes persistent local memory traversal separating content utility from address geometry.
papers.summary_zh: 提出持续的局部记忆遍历，将内容效用与地址几何分离。

papers.title: Gym-Anything for Robotics: Scaling physical simulations with digital agents
papers.summary_en: Gym-Anything uses coding agents and adversarial audits to create physics simulations and tasks; accumulated Markdown lessons improve later builds. RoboWorld contains 25 simulations, 25 test tasks and 175 training environments, including liquids, cloth and chemistry.
papers.summary_zh: Gym-Anything 通过编码代理和对抗审计生成物理仿真与任务，用 Markdown 经验积累改进后续构建。RoboWorld 包含 25 仿真、25 测试任务和 175 训练环境，覆盖液体、布料和化学。

papers.title: L3G-World: Real-Time Infinite World Generation with Latent 3D Gaussian Memory
papers.summary_en: Updates compact 3D Gaussian memory storing VAE features, rendering conditioning directly in latent space.
papers.summary_zh: 维护存储 VAE 特征的紧凑三维高斯记忆，直接在潜空间渲染条件。

papers.title: When More Planning Hurts: Learned Planners for World Models
papers.summary_en: A small learned action updater probes whether minimizing a learned world-model objective more aggressively can worsen actual control. The paper foregrounds its own unsuccessful preregistered task-cost criterion.
papers.summary_zh: 小型学习动作更新器检验更积极优化世界模型代价是否反而损害控制，并明确报告自身未达到预先设定的任务—成本标准。

papers.title: SaiVLA-JEPA: Evaluating Future Latent Prediction in JEPA-Conditioned VLA Control
papers.summary_en: SaiVLA-JEPA distinguishes gains from current predictive-encoder features from gains due to future-latent training, and separately audits context adaptation and parameter updates.
papers.summary_zh: SaiVLA-JEPA区分当前预测编码器特征的收益与未来潜变量训练的收益，并分别审计上下文适配与参数更新。

papers.title: Generating Critic-Guided Synthetic Experience in Latent World Models
papers.summary_en: Fine-tunes an offline flow actor on critic-refined synthetic actions with frozen LeWM dynamics and critic. Stored transitions are one-step, but generation can chain up to 40 model steps.
papers.summary_zh: 用 critic 改进的合成动作微调离线 flow actor，冻结 LeWM 动力学与 critic。存储单步转移，但生成可串联至 40 个模型步。

papers.title: Seeing and Imagining as One: Unified Video Generation and 4D Perception for Embodied World Modeling
papers.summary_en: GenSight jointly models future video, depth, embodiment segmentation and first-frame-relative 2D flow in one pretrained video DiT with task modulation and a common velocity objective.
papers.summary_zh: GenSight 在一个预训练视频 DiT 内，以任务调制和统一速度目标联合建模未来视频、深度、本体分割及相对首帧的 2D 光流。

papers.title: WorldFlow: Joint Video and 3D Motion Prediction via Large-Scale Pretraining
papers.summary_en: WorldFlow jointly predicts video and query-based 3D trajectories with aligned displacement tokens and a rectified-flow mixture-of-transformers. WorldFlowBench evaluates geometry-sensitive future prediction.
papers.summary_zh: WorldFlow 以对齐的位移 token 和 rectified-flow 混合 Transformer 联合预测视频与查询式 3D 轨迹，并以 WorldFlowBench 测试几何未来预测。

papers.title: Utility-WAM: Correcting Future-Induced Action Changes
papers.summary_en: Utility-WAM audits the action change caused by imagined futures, repairs harmful deltas with a residual adapter, and skips future generation when an offline utility gate predicts little benefit.
papers.summary_zh: Utility-WAM审计想象未来造成的动作变化，以残差适配器修复有害增量，并由离线效用门控跳过低收益未来生成。

papers.title: PRIME W0: Physical Priors from World Models for Embodied Manipulation
papers.summary_en: PRIME W0 combines per-layer VLM key/value conditioning, asynchronous subgoal-image prediction, frozen-DINOv2 history tokens and an adaptive-MoE flow action decoder. Covariance-shaped action noise encodes correlations from demonstrations.
papers.summary_zh: PRIME W0 结合逐层 VLM KV 条件、异步子目标图像预测、冻结 DINOv2 历史编码及自适应 MoE 流动作解码器；动作噪声协方差来自示范相关结构。

papers.title: From Reasoning to Action: Consequence-Grounded Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.summary_en: CoRAct turns movement descriptions and future waypoints into action-alignment rewards. A shared transformer predicts reasoning, actions and action-conditioned futures; group-relative optimization steers initial action noise toward matching the stated consequences.
papers.summary_zh: CoRAct 将运动描述和未来路点变成动作对齐奖励；共享 Transformer 建模推理、动作及动作条件未来，并用组相对优化调整初始动作噪声，使执行符合预期后果。

papers.title: WorldProbe: When Video World Models Fall Apart under Long-Horizon Spatial Exploration
papers.summary_en: An adaptive camera-control agent probes long-horizon consistency rather than scoring only fixed short videos.
papers.summary_zh: 用自适应相机控制智能体测试长时一致性，而非只评估固定短视频。

papers.title: PASA-KV: Attacking Action-Facing Visual Routes in World Action Models
papers.summary_en: PASA-KV studies adversarial vulnerability at WAM visual key/value pathways. Its Tail-AV probe selects representations that action queries actually depend on, instead of treating large latent displacement as equivalent to behavioral damage.
papers.summary_zh: PASA-KV 研究 WAM 视觉 KV 路径的对抗脆弱性；Tail-AV 探针寻找动作查询真正依赖的路径，而不是把潜变量变化幅度等同于行为损害。

papers.title: RoboSeed: Multidimensional Evaluation of Vision-Language-Action and World-Action Models: Capability, Resource Affordability, and Research Evidence
papers.summary_en: RoboSeed separates capability, training cost, deployment cost, local research-value evidence and reproduction evidence into explicit profiles with fixed scoring anchors and budget-dependent preferences.
papers.summary_zh: RoboSeed 将能力、训练成本、部署成本、本地研究价值证据与复现证据分成明确维度，用固定锚点和预算偏好构建画像。

papers.title: HiFOR: Hierarchical Foresight with Action-Guided World Grounding for Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.summary_en: HiFOR predicts short-term states, semantic milestones and final goals with a hierarchical dependency mask, organizes latent futures by horizon/view/space, and lets evolving action tokens retrieve relevant future information during denoising.
papers.summary_zh: HiFOR 通过分层依赖掩码联合预测短期状态、语义里程碑和最终目标；按时间视野、视角和空间组织潜在未来，让动作 token 在去噪时检索所需信息。

papers.title: Continuous-Action World Models: Learning Cross-Embodiment Spatiotemporal Dynamics Priors
papers.summary_en: CoAWM learns a shared latent action-function space across embodiments and sampling rates, then conditions that function through a world-model backbone; querying a time returns an end-effector command.
papers.summary_zh: CoAWM 跨本体和采样率预训练共享潜在动作函数空间，再由世界模型骨干条件化该函数；查询任意时间获得末端动作。

papers.title: world2vec: Mechanistic world models through latent dynamics learning
papers.summary_en: Learns action-conditioned latent dynamics without reward information; authors claim compact models with faithful long-horizon prediction.
papers.summary_zh: 不使用奖励信息学习动作条件潜在动力学，目标是兼顾紧凑性和长期预测保真度。

papers.title: What Actually Matters? A Paired Evaluation of Inference Settings for $π_{0.5}$ on BEHAVIOR-1K
papers.summary_en: This paired study treats inference settings as experimentally testable interventions rather than transferable defaults. Chunk execution horizon matters strongly, whereas denoising effort and overlap inpainting show no detectable gain in this setting.
papers.summary_zh: 配对研究把推理设置当作需要验证的干预，而非可直接迁移的默认值：执行块长度影响显著，去噪次数和重叠修补在该设置下无可检测收益。

papers.title: Self-Labeled Preference Transfer for Steerable Robot Manipulation
papers.summary_en: SPT jointly trains preference recognition and preference-conditioned actions, freezes recognition, then pseudo-labels new-task demonstrations before adapting the policy. This preserves how-to-execute control that bare-task fine-tuning loses.
papers.summary_zh: SPT联合学习偏好识别与条件动作，冻结识别器，为新任务示范补伪标签再适配策略，保留普通微调易遗失的执行偏好。

papers.title: Embodied at Sea: Imitation Learning for Multi-Task Underwater Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Underwater imitation learning exposes a large gap between pool performance and marine field deployment, offering a useful counterweight to generalist-VLA assumptions.
papers.summary_zh: 水下模仿学习揭示泳池与海洋实地部署之间的巨大差距，为通用VLA能力判断提供现实校准。

papers.title: Quantize by Doing: Task-Guided Mixed-Precision Quantization of Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.summary_en: QbD-VLA uses short closed-loop task tests to allocate mixed precision, optimizing what the robot succeeds at rather than calibration error alone.
papers.summary_zh: QbD-VLA用短闭环任务试验分配混合精度，优化机器人实际成功而非仅校准误差。

papers.title: UMI-Live for In-The-Wild Bimanual Robotics Data Collection
papers.summary_en: UMI-Live packages bimanual field demonstrations into a collection-to-training pipeline with onboard sensing, asynchronous SLAM and VLA deployment tools.
papers.summary_zh: UMI-Live把双臂野外示范采集、机载感知、异步SLAM和VLA训练部署串成完整流程。

papers.title: Decoding Geometry, Not Tokens: Efficient VLMs for Robot Affordance and Trajectory Prediction
papers.summary_en: A lightweight continuous geometry head reads frozen intermediate VLM features to predict affordance boxes and waypoints without autoregressive coordinate tokens.
papers.summary_zh: 轻量连续几何头读取冻结VLM中间特征，直接预测可供性框与路径点，避免自回归坐标token。

papers.title: Smooth Action Chunking Via Movement-Primitive Representations for Imitation Learning
papers.summary_en: Smooth movement-primitive coefficients replace raw action chunks; an inference-time via-point correction aligns each new chunk with the last commanded action without retraining.
papers.summary_zh: 以平滑运动基元系数替代原始动作段，并用推理时经过点修正将新段接上上一条执行动作，无需重新训练。

papers.title: How Much Should a VLA Trust Its Reasoning? Step-Level Guidance as a Measured Action-Value Function
papers.summary_en: CoC-CFG treats reasoning strength as a per-denoising-step control variable between reasoning-conditioned and reasoning-removed predictions. With fixed expert and noise, completed rollouts measure action values that train small conservative guidance critics.
papers.summary_zh: CoC-CFG 将推理条件与去推理条件之间的引导强度作为逐去噪步控制变量；固定专家和噪声后，通过完整 rollout 测得动作价值，训练小型保守引导 critic。

papers.title: Learning Safe Flow Matching Robot Policies from Binary Feasibility Oracles
papers.summary_en: An oracle-guided safeguard uses binary feasibility checks to repair unsafe flow updates and infer local boundary gradients, aligning training and inference without analytic constraints.
papers.summary_zh: 基于二值可行性 oracle 修正不安全流更新，并估计局部边界梯度，无需解析约束即可让训练和推理使用同一防护机制。

papers.title: Gaussian Distillation of Flow Policies
papers.summary_en: Gaussian Action Readout replaces a flow policy output layer with a Gaussian model while freezing its backbone, providing one-pass sampling and closed-form likelihoods.
papers.summary_zh: Gaussian Action Readout 冻结流策略骨干，将输出层改为高斯读出，获得单次前向采样和闭式似然。

papers.title: TouchBridge: Tactile-Conditioned Human-to-Robot Transfer for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.summary_en: TouchBridge co-designs human and robot visual/tactile interfaces and retargets fingertip contact patches without object meshes, poses or physics simulation. Converted human demonstrations fine-tune a VLA.
papers.summary_zh: TouchBridge 协同设计人类与机器人视觉/触觉接口，无需物体网格、位姿或仿真即可重定向指尖接触区域，再以转换的人类示范微调 VLA。

papers.title: Improving Fine-Grained Manipulation through Demonstration Expansion and Execution Design
papers.summary_en: DEED adapts a VLA with instruction/visual demonstration expansion, balanced sampling and task-specific chunk-to-control execution design.
papers.summary_zh: DEED 通过指令与视觉示范扩展、均衡采样以及任务特定动作段执行设计来适配 VLA。

papers.title: BURGER: Benchmarking and Understanding Robotic Generalization via Embodied Drawing
papers.summary_en: BURGER uses language-conditioned robot drawing to separate language grounding, spatial composition and multimodal trajectory choice while scaling demonstrations cheaply.
papers.summary_zh: BURGER 用语言条件机器人绘画，在低成本扩大示范时区分语言定位、空间组合与多模态轨迹选择。

papers.title: Echo: Scaling Visual Reinforcement Learning with Off-policy Experience
papers.summary_en: Echo amortizes visual RL cost by having a state-only auxiliary actor imitate the visual actor and collect unrendered off-policy experience for their privileged critic.
papers.summary_zh: Echo 让状态辅助策略模仿视觉策略并采集无需渲染的离策略经验，共享特权critic以降低视觉RL成本。

papers.title: Learning from Relative Action Credit for Escaping Local Minima
papers.summary_en: Relative action credit augments PPO with an action-conditioned critic comparing executed actions with alternatives at the same state, seeking to escape partial-solution plateaus.
papers.summary_zh: 相对动作信用在 PPO 中加入动作条件 critic，比较同一状态下执行动作与替代动作，以突破局部解平台。

papers.title: Force-Driven Hook Disassembly via Constraint-Aware Object-Centric Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary_en: A robot-agnostic object-centric RL policy uses force history and particle-filter beliefs to infer feasible extraction directions for hidden hook constraints.
papers.summary_zh: 与机器人无关的物体中心RL策略结合力历史及粒子滤波信念，推断隐藏卡钩约束的可行拔出方向。

papers.title: Catch It All!: Generalizable Dynamic Catching with a Dexterous Hand
papers.summary_en: Catch It All learns camera-driven dexterous catching in simulation with grasp rewards and safety-aware curricula, then deploys without real-policy tuning.
papers.summary_zh: Catch It All通过抓取奖励及安全课程在仿真学习视觉灵巧接物，免真机策略微调部署。

papers.title: Robotic Data Inoculation
papers.summary_en: Data Inoculation learns residual perturbations during human teleoperation so corrections cover states likely to be visited by the eventual learned policy.
papers.summary_zh: Data Inoculation在人类遥操作中学习残差扰动，使人类纠正覆盖未来策略可能访问的偏离状态。

papers.title: Event2Reward: Learning Robotic Rewards from Progress Relations
papers.summary_en: Event2Reward uses relative progress relations from stalls, regressions and recoveries to prevent reward models from rewarding backwards movement, while temporal labels anchor the overall scale.
papers.summary_zh: Event2Reward利用停滞、倒退、恢复的相对进度关系，防止奖励模型鼓励倒退，并用时间标签锚定总进度尺度。

papers.title: Coupled Guidance for Flow Matching
papers.summary_en: Coupled Guidance derives flow-specific sampling control from the training coupling rather than directly importing diffusion guidance, aiming to avoid destabilizing that coupling.
papers.summary_zh: Coupled Guidance 从训练耦合结构推导流匹配专用采样引导，而非直接移植扩散引导，避免破坏耦合稳定性。

papers.title: Escaping Path Mirages in Offline Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary_en: Branch-aware graph planning avoids spurious successful offline trajectories caused by stochastic branching.
papers.summary_zh: 用分支感知图规划避免随机分支导致的离线虚假成功轨迹。

papers.title: DexSuite: An All-in-One Framework for Dexterous Manipulation Across Arms, Hands, and Tasks
papers.summary_en: DexSuite unifies dexterous simulation, teleoperation, tactile sensing and policy evaluation across interchangeable arms and hands. The contribution is reusable research infrastructure rather than a new manipulation policy.
papers.summary_zh: DexSuite 将灵巧操作仿真、遥操作、触觉及策略评估整合到可组合机械臂与手的平台；贡献是研究基础设施而非新策略。

papers.title: Same Label, Different Interface: Beyond Action-Space Labels in Robot Learning
papers.summary_en: Action-space labels hide the actual execution interface: filtering, physical scaling, feedback and timing can dominate apparent position-versus-velocity differences.
papers.summary_zh: 动作空间标签掩盖实际执行接口；滤波、物理尺度、反馈与时序可能主导位置/速度控制差异。

papers.title: CuraEval: Evaluating Demonstration Curation on Mixed-Skill Robot Data
papers.summary_en: CuraEval tests demonstration curation against size-matched random subsets and full-data training, showing that attractive scores and favorable reporting choices can mislead.
papers.summary_zh: CuraEval用等量随机子集与全数据训练检验示范筛选，揭示评分指标及报告协议可能制造误导。

papers.title: SimRetract: Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Robotic Assistance for Retractor Take-Over in Open Surgery
papers.summary_en: SimRetract learns a surgical retractor handoff from simulated demonstrations using instrument masking, grasp geometry and recovery-oriented data.
papers.summary_zh: SimRetract通过器械掩码、抓取几何与恢复导向仿真数据学习牵开器交接。

papers.title: Language-Grounded Force/Torque Pretraining for Extrinsic Contact Perception
papers.summary_en: Force/torque pretraining aligns bilateral histories with frozen language embeddings to make contact-related physical states reusable across objects and tasks.
papers.summary_zh: 力/力矩预训练把双侧历史与冻结语言嵌入对齐，使接触物理状态可跨物体任务复用。

papers.title: Kinematic-Tactile Aligned Dexterous Retargeting with Contact Wrench Space Alignment
papers.summary_en: A three-stage retargeting pipeline preserves both human-hand kinematics and tactile contact-wrench support, then converts optimized robot force targets into executable joint corrections.
papers.summary_zh: 三阶段重定向同时保留人手运动学和触觉接触力旋量支撑，再将机器人目标指尖力转为可执行关节修正。

papers.title: TactoHand: Learning Geometry-Based Dense Hand-Surface Interaction Fields from Video
papers.summary_en: Predicts hand-surface contact, proximity and force from monocular video using geometry and motion-derived supervision.
papers.summary_zh: 从单目视频预测手表面接触、距离与力，监督来自几何和运动推导。

papers.title: PhysAg3D: Bridging 3D Generative and Agentic Models for High-Fidelity and Physically-Interactive Assets
papers.summary_en: Couples generated meshes with agentic construction and bounded refinement of joints, compliant regions and surface bindings.
papers.summary_zh: 结合生成网格与智能体构建，在固定预算内修正关节、柔顺区域和表面绑定。

papers.title: AcrossDEX 1.0: From Human Motion Pretraining to Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation across Hand Embodiments
papers.summary_en: AcrossDEX transfers human bimanual motion pretraining into robot action prediction using shared wrists, separate finger representations and validity masks across Inspire and Allegro hands. It compares regression and generative decoders with receding-horizon execution.
papers.summary_zh: AcrossDEX 以共享手腕、独立手指表示和有效性掩码，将人类双手运动预训练适配至 Inspire 与 Allegro 机器人手，并比较回归与生成解码的滚动执行。

papers.title: SwapBot: Tool-Centric Robot Manipulation via Interchangeable End-Effectors and Tactile Sensing
papers.summary_en: SwapBot combines a fixed robot coupling with inexpensive tactile tool adapters, autonomous swapping and demonstration collection; imitation policies use the resulting tactile-rich data.
papers.summary_zh: SwapBot 以固定机器人连接接口和低成本触觉工具适配器支持自主换工具及示范采集，再训练使用触觉数据的模仿策略。

papers.title: SpaceAct: Benchmarking 3D Spatial and Temporal Reasoning via Closed-Loop Action and Active Perception
papers.summary_en: SpaceAct evaluates spatial reasoning through active camera control and executed 6-DoF actions with collisions and statics, rather than static visual questions.
papers.summary_zh: SpaceAct通过主动视角和受碰撞、静力约束的6自由度执行评测空间推理，而非静态视觉问答。

papers.title: OmniVIC: A Self-Improving Variable Impedance Controller with Vision-Language In-Context Learning for Safe Robotic Manipulation
papers.summary_en: OmniVIC retrieves past interaction records to prompt a VLM for variable-impedance gains. Revision clarifies safety termination, controller rates and baseline gains, and adds an explicit five-trial hardware success statement; the headline simulation result is not new.
papers.summary_zh: OmniVIC 检索过去交互记录，以提示 VLM 生成可变阻抗参数。本次修订明确安全终止规则、控制频率与基线增益，并补充五次实机试验的成功率陈述；主要仿真结果并非新增。

papers.title: Train the Agent, Not the Expert: Learning to Harness Heterogeneous Experts for Multi-Turn Visual Reasoning
papers.summary_en: VisHarness v2 adds RL-only, visual-memory archiving and interaction-budget ablations, and revises the reported evaluation of a trained agent using fixed visual experts.
papers.summary_zh: VisHarness v2 补充 RL-only、视觉记忆归档和交互轮数消融，并修订训练智能体调用固定视觉专家的评估。

papers.title: SkillHone: A Harness for Continual Agent Skill Evolution Through Persistent Decision History
papers.summary_en: Adds development-cost evidence to a persistent-history skill-evolution harness; the method and headline accuracy results already appear in v3.
papers.summary_zh: 为持续决策历史驱动的技能演化框架增加开发成本证据；方法和主要准确率结果已在 v3 出现。

papers.title: GUI-AC: Enhancing Continual Learning in GUI Agents
papers.summary_en: GUI-AC targets continual grounding under interface-domain and resolution shifts with rollout-specific advantage and clipping updates. v2 uniformly downweighted low-certainty groups; v3 amplifies negative advantages only for high-probability failures. Upper clipping expands only for low-probability positive-advantage exploration; lower clipping stays fixed. Probability ratio now uses old rollout policy, not reference policy.
papers.summary_zh: GUI-AC 针对界面领域及分辨率变化，通过逐轨迹优势与裁剪更新实现持续定位学习。 v2 对低确定性组整体降权；v3 仅放大高概率失败的负优势，仅对低概率正优势探索放宽上裁剪界，下界固定；概率比改用旧采样策略而非参考策略。

papers.title: VLA-Corrector: Lightweight Detect-and-Correct Inference for Adaptive Action Horizon
papers.summary_en: VLA-Corrector combines learned latent-dynamics monitoring, event-triggered chunk truncation and recovery-directed gradient guidance without updating the VLA backbone. Revision adds deployment cost accounting and a direct asynchronous, matched-call RTC comparison.
papers.summary_zh: VLA-Corrector 用学习到的潜在动力学监测、事件触发动作块截断及恢复方向梯度引导，在不更新 VLA 主干的情况下纠偏。本次修订新增部署开销核算和异步、近似匹配调用预算的 RTC 对比。

papers.title: Detector Confidence Signals Presence Rather Than Occlusion in Cluttered Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Separates category-detection confidence from visibility and localization of the intended physical instance. v3 narrows earlier detector-general and single-view impossibility claims. The 5%→100% result is explicitly combined additional-view selection and fusion over 40 scenes—not a single camera motion or end-to-end manipulation result. Adds cost/scope caveats.
papers.summary_zh: 区分类别检测置信度与指定物理实例的可见性、定位可靠性。 v3 收窄此前跨检测器和单视角不可能性的表述；5%→100% 明确是 40 场景的额外视角选择加融合效果，并非单次相机移动或端到端操作；增加成本与范围限制。

papers.title: Generalizable VLA Finetuning via Representation Anchoring and Language-Action Alignment
papers.summary_en: Anchor-Align constrains VLM representational drift and aligns motion with language during VLA finetuning. Revision adds semantic-label controls and expands hardware evidence across architectures and embodiments.
papers.summary_zh: Anchor-Align 在 VLA 微调中约束 VLM 表征漂移，并对齐运动与语言。本次修订新增语义标签对照，扩展不同架构与机器人形态的实机证据。

papers.title: Evidence-Gated Task and Motion Planning with Vision-Language Models
papers.summary_en: EAFG explicitly acquires visual evidence before task planning and gates between further exploration, planning and halting. Revision adds an exploration-and-halting prompted baseline and revises evaluation criteria and reported results.
papers.summary_zh: EAFG 在任务规划前主动获取视觉证据，并决定继续探索、开始规划或停止。本次修订新增带探索与停止提示的基线，更新评价口径及实验结果。

papers.title: Learning and Transferring Closed-Loop Robot Software
papers.summary_en: Execution-improved closed-loop policy code becomes an archive for acquiring new robot tasks. Revision adds physical Unitree G1 validation, while retaining the earlier RoboCasa cross-task transfer study.
papers.summary_zh: 把经过执行反馈改进的闭环策略代码保存为档案，供新任务学习参考。本次修订新增 Unitree G1 实机验证，保留此前的 RoboCasa 跨任务迁移实验。

papers.title: ActionUNet: Improving Robustness of VLA Models with Efficient Multi-scale Fine-tuning
papers.summary_en: ActionUNet adds multiscale temporal features and continuous action decoding to VLA finetuning. This revision contracts, rather than expands, the supplementary evidence.
papers.summary_zh: ActionUNet 通过多尺度时序特征与连续动作解码改进 VLA 微调。本次修订缩减而非扩充了补充证据。

papers.title: Combining Constrained Sampling and Reinforcement Learning for Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Constrained sampling supplies contact-feasible reset and goal states for goal-conditioned RL. v3 expands the evaluation to Allegro in-hand and upside-down manipulation and updates training settings and cube-task results.
papers.summary_zh: 用约束采样提供接触可行的重置与目标状态，辅助目标条件 RL。v3 扩展到 Allegro 手内及倒置操作，并更新训练设置及方块任务结果。

papers.title: Latent Policy Steering through One-Step Flow Policies
papers.summary_en: LPS steers a one-step MeanFlow prior using action-space Q-gradients. v3 revises offline-to-online interpretation and detailed scores, and removes the auxiliary LPSD distillation appendix.
papers.summary_zh: LPS 利用动作空间 Q 梯度引导单步 MeanFlow 先验。v3 修订离线到在线学习的解释及详细成绩，并移除辅助 LPSD 蒸馏附录。

papers.title: RE4: Transformation-aware Imitation of Object Interactions Using Manipulation Modes
papers.summary_en: RE4 retrieves, transforms, replans and replays demonstrations according to manipulation modes. v2 adds pose-estimation variants, a real mug task, distractor and obstacle studies, and a VINN baseline.
papers.summary_zh: RE4 按操作模式检索、变换、重规划和回放示范。v2 新增位姿估计变体、真实杯子任务、干扰物与障碍物实验，以及 VINN 基线。

papers.title: Mixture of Frames Policy: Multi-Frame Action Denoising for Bimanual Mobile Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Mixture of Frames fuses frame-specialized diffusion predictions in a canonical action representation. v2 adds frame-set scalability experiments and stronger capacity/geometry-aware comparisons.
papers.summary_zh: Mixture of Frames 在统一动作表示中融合坐标系专属扩散预测。v2 新增坐标系集合扩展实验，以及更强的容量与几何感知对照。

papers.title: Certified Behavioral Retention for Continual Adaptation with Held-Out Anchors
papers.summary_en: CABA gates candidate updates using held-out historical anchors and worst-anchor forward KL, choosing the largest tested interpolation within a declared retention budget.
papers.summary_zh: CABA用保留历史锚点上的最坏前向KL筛选候选更新，选择满足行为保留预算的最大已测试插值步长。

papers.title: DyCraft: An Agentic System for Long-Horizon 4D Scene Generation
papers.summary_en: A coding-agent harness decomposes 4D animation into verified static storyboards and locally authored motion, with explicit physical checks.
papers.summary_zh: 代码智能体框架把4D动画拆成经过验证的静态分镜和局部运动，并加入显式物理检查。

papers.title: AutoHebb: Self-Modifying Neural Networks that Zero-Shot Infer and Continually Learn
papers.summary_en: AutoHebb meta-learns fixed weights that regulate online Hebbian plasticity without an externally supplied learning-phase signal.
papers.summary_zh: AutoHebb元学习固定权重，自主调节在线Hebbian可塑性，不依赖外部提供学习阶段信号。

papers.title: More Rules, Longer Lists? Benchmarking Self-Evolving Agents on a Hidden-Rule Curriculum
papers.summary_en: CLR-Bench separates hidden-rule learning from accumulating exceptions in persistent state.
papers.summary_zh: CLR-Bench区分隐含规则学习与持久状态中的例外累积。

papers.title: CaPtain: A Pipeline for Post-Training Code-as-Policy Robot Agents
papers.summary_en: Post-trains a 4B code-as-policy agent via synthetic SFT and multi-turn RL with a privileged physical-state critic.
papers.summary_zh: 通过合成SFT与多轮RL训练4B代码策略机器人，利用特权物理状态评论家分配信用。

papers.title: EgoHSI3R: Online 4D Hand-Scene Interaction Reconstruction from Egocentric Video
papers.summary_en: A recurrent shared scene representation jointly reconstructs camera, scene, bilateral hands and dense contact from causal monocular video.
papers.summary_zh: 利用循环共享场景表示，从因果单目视频联合重建相机、场景、双手及稠密接触。

papers.title: P-ContextBench: From Personal Fact Recall to Personalized Agent Behavior
papers.summary_en: P-ContextBench evaluates temporal context reconstruction and evidence-grounded behavior, beyond recalling stored facts.
papers.summary_zh: P-ContextBench超越事实回忆，评测时间状态重建与证据支持的行为。

papers.title: Accept Changes, Reject Attacks: Robust Memory Management for LLM Agents
papers.summary_en: Trains memory updates to accept legitimate changes and reject poisoning; evidence-conditioned accuracy checks answers and supporting records.
papers.summary_zh: 训练记忆更新接受真实变化并拒绝投毒，以证据条件准确率检查回答及支撑记录。

papers.title: TalentRL: Strategy-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Hierarchical Skill Routing
papers.summary_en: Hierarchical talents guide skill retrieval; matched intervention rollouts separate routing credit from execution credit.
papers.summary_zh: 高层策略指导技能检索，匹配干预轨迹区分路由与执行贡献。

papers.title: Lineage Is Memory: Parent Inheritance and Feedback Disclosure in Short-Budget LLM-Guided Optimization
papers.summary_en: Factorial study separates inherited candidate state from failure-feedback breadth in iterative prompt/program optimization.
papers.summary_zh: 因子实验将迭代提示／程序优化中的候选继承状态与失败反馈覆盖范围分开。

papers.title: TinyAstral: Transferring Self-Evolving Harnesses to Tiny Generalist Manipulation Agents
papers.summary_en: Statistically gated harness evolution improves a frozen teacher; reasoning/recovery trajectories distill gains into a 4B student.
papers.summary_zh: 用统计检验筛选执行框架修改，提升冻结教师，再通过推理与恢复轨迹蒸馏至4B学生。

papers.title: Learning from Physical Experience:Context-Space Adaptation for Robotic Manipulation
papers.summary_en: LEXP adapts a frozen reasoner's context using planning and retained condition-specific lessons; this is not weight-updating RL.
papers.summary_zh: LEXP通过规划及带适用条件的交互经验调整冻结模型上下文，并非更新权重的强化学习。

papers.title: BioAgent: Self-Directed Skill Acquisition and Capability Growth for Long-Horizon Laboratory Protocols
papers.summary_en: Combines validated skill packages, tool selection, human teaching and execution-state checks for laboratory protocols.
papers.summary_zh: 结合技能包验证、工具选择、人工教学与实验状态检查，支持长流程实验操作。

papers.title: Beyond Trial-and-Error: A Geospatial-Guided Active Reasoning Framework for Robust Aerial Vision-and-Language Navigation
papers.summary_en: GeoReasoner combines geospatial hypotheses, active evidence acquisition, exploration memory and adversarial consistency checks for aerial navigation.
papers.summary_zh: GeoReasoner结合地理空间假设、主动取证、探索记忆与对抗一致性检查，实现航拍视觉语言导航。

papers.title: KEEPER: Learning Control-Sufficient Textual Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.summary_en: Compares four auxiliary supervision objectives in a shared recursive textual-memory interface, separating task utility from memory reliability.
papers.summary_zh: 在统一递归文本记忆接口中比较四种辅助监督目标，区分任务表现与记忆可靠性。

papers.title: Verify--Backtrack Loop: Structured Precondition Recovery for Long-Horizon Language Agents
papers.summary_en: Verify–Backtrack Loop maintains a goal stack and uses typed failures to push prerequisites, retry or backtrack under explicit budgets.
papers.summary_zh: Verify–Backtrack Loop维护目标栈，根据失败类型在明确预算内补前提、重试或回退。

papers.title: When the Past Shapes Action: Understanding Embodied Memory
papers.summary_en: Survey organizes embodied memory by six requirements and eight architectures.
papers.summary_zh: 综述六需求、八类架构。

papers.title: SketchMate: Agentic Geometric Reasoning for Zero-Shot Precision Insertion
papers.summary_en: Stores geometric sketches for registration-based reuse and close-range correction.
papers.summary_zh: 存储几何草图进行配准复用和近距离修正。

papers.title: META-Robot: Self-Cognition and Capability Scaling in Agentic Robots
papers.summary_en: Couples executable skills with verification predicates, expanding both via repaired execution and proprioception.
papers.summary_zh: 关联技能与验证谓词，通过修复和本体感受扩展。

papers.title: TwinPast: Benchmarking Historical Evidence Use in Streaming Video Understanding with Evidence Contrastive Video Pairs
papers.summary_en: Pairs videos with identical recent context but different histories to test whether streaming models actually use memory.
papers.summary_zh: 通过近期画面相同、历史不同的视频对，检测流式模型是否真正使用记忆。

papers.title: REA: A Routed Embodied Agent Runtime for Asynchronous Brain-Cerebellum Control
papers.summary_en: Nonblocking runtime combines historical-success routing, boundary-triggered judging and bounded recovery.
papers.summary_zh: 非阻塞运行时结合历史路由、边界评价、有界恢复。

papers.title: RoboArchitect: Automating the Design of Robotic Agents with Persistent Memory
papers.summary_en: A coding agent evolves control orchestration and persistent memory around frozen policies.
papers.summary_zh: 编码智能体优化冻结策略的控制框架与持久记忆。

papers.title: WorldBridge: Bridging Video and Action for Task Generalization in World Action Models
papers.summary_en: Connects separate video/action experts using structured attention, joint flow matching and two-scale visual memory.
papers.summary_zh: 通过结构化注意力、联合流匹配与双尺度视觉记忆连接视频和动作专家。

papers.title: Agentic World Modeling for Agent Test-time Scaling without Environment Replica
papers.summary_en: Read-only evidence acquisition and executable computation simulate hypothetical observations without replicating or mutating shared environments.
papers.summary_zh: 利用只读证据和可执行计算模拟假想观测，无需复制或修改共享环境。

papers.title: Let LiDAR Decide Where to Look: Geometry-Measured Token Selection for Efficient Sparse Latent World Models
papers.summary_en: LiDAR/radar geometry selects patches before visual encoding; 3D-anchored latent prediction supports driving planning.
papers.summary_zh: 在视觉编码前利用激光雷达/雷达几何选择图像块，借助三维锚定潜在预测支持驾驶规划。

papers.title: UFMF: Radar-Guided Kinematic Priors for Real-Time 4D Occupancy Forecasting
papers.summary_en: A lightweight state-space forecaster combines radar-guided motion residuals with world-frame and vertical-geometry supervision.
papers.summary_zh: 轻量状态空间预测器结合雷达引导运动残差、世界坐标及垂直几何监督。

papers.title: Density-Guided Bootstrap Boundaries for Latent World-Model Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary_en: Adds density-proxy hard/soft bootstrap boundaries to DreamerV3 imagined returns without changing the world-model transition process.
papers.summary_zh: 在DreamerV3想象回报中加入密度代理驱动的硬/软bootstrap边界，不替换世界模型转移过程。

papers.title: Before We Adapt: The Zero-Shot Generalization Bottleneck in Continual World Models
papers.summary_en: Separates physical and behavioral context changes and diagnoses zero-shot reuse before continual adaptation.
papers.summary_zh: 区分物理与行为上下文变化，在持续适应之前诊断世界模型零样本复用。

papers.title: One Verdict Is Not Enough: Regression Testing Learned World Models and Their Test Harnesses
papers.summary_en: TetraState versions the test harness alongside the learned world model and tracks per-test outcome transitions across four native configurations.
papers.summary_zh: TetraState将测试框架与世界模型共同版本化，追踪四种原生配置下逐测试结果变化。

papers.title: SPT-Flow: One Integration, Many Futures in Continuous-Time World Models
papers.summary_en: SPT-Flow matches free-running continuous-time rollouts using one latent per trajectory to test a teacher-forcing shortcut.
papers.summary_zh: SPT-Flow以每轨迹单个潜变量监督自由运行连续时间轨迹，检验教师强制产生的捷径。

papers.title: Cross-Embodiment Motion Planning by Coupling Body-Agnostic World Model with Differentiable Ego-Dynamics
papers.summary_en: Hourglass links an embodiment-independent world model to parameterized differentiable robot dynamics through camera ego-motion, training a shared planner in imagination.
papers.summary_zh: Hourglass以相机自运动连接本体无关世界模型与参数化可微动力学，在想象中训练共享规划策略。

papers.title: MolmoSpaces-CommonSense: Evaluating Commonsense in Robotic Manipulation Policies
papers.summary_en: Benchmarks embodied commonsense involving clutter, occlusion, support, affordances and hidden objects.
papers.summary_zh: 评估杂乱、遮挡、支撑关系、可供性和隐藏物体等操作常识。

papers.title: When the Simulator Fails, Not the Policy: Auditing Contact Artifacts in Simulated Robot Benchmarks
papers.summary_en: SimuGuard detects contact artifacts with replay and single-parameter counterfactual reruns.
papers.summary_zh: 检测接触伪影，支持回放与单参数反事实重跑。

papers.title: When Does Test-Time Search Help World Action Models? An Empirical Audit of Candidate Selection and Simulator Integrity
papers.summary_en: A premise-first audit tests candidate-selection signal, realized speedup and simulator integrity for Cosmos Policy on RoboCasa.
papers.summary_zh: 针对Cosmos Policy在RoboCasa中的候选选择信号、实际加速和仿真完整性进行前提审计。

papers.title: GeoFlip: Benchmarking Geometry-Sensitive Physics in Video Generation
papers.summary_en: Geometry interventions flip simulated physical outcomes while prompts stay fixed, testing causal responsiveness rather than visual plausibility.
papers.summary_zh: 保持提示不变，通过几何干预翻转仿真物理结果，检验模型是否响应因果条件而非仅生成逼真画面。

papers.title: Hierarchical World Models with Implicit Dynamics
papers.summary_en: ID-WM searches diffusion-generated reachable subgoals and realizes them through a low-level world model.
papers.summary_zh: 搜索扩散生成可达子目标，以低层世界模型实现。

papers.title: STAR: Steering Action Representations during Inference
papers.summary_en: Training-free single-pass steering mixes late-layer residual updates, controlled by recent proprioception.
papers.summary_zh: 无需训练、单次前向地混合后层残差更新，由近期本体状态控制强度。

papers.title: VLA Policies Do Not Know When Not to Act: Unintended Task Execution and Start Suppression
papers.summary_en: Paired instructions separate movement initiation from task selection at identical initial states.
papers.summary_zh: 同初态配对指令区分启动与选择。

papers.title: Nexus-VLA: Bridging Human and Robot Experiences via a Shared Hierarchical Semantic Latent Space
papers.summary_en: Joint human–robot training aligns intent and fine interactions into action latents.
papers.summary_zh: 人机联合训练对齐意图、细交互与动作潜变量。

papers.title: HandMimicX: Learning Human-Like Dexterous Manipulation via an Object-Centric Policy from Egocentric Videos
papers.summary_en: Learns object-centric dexterous skills from RGB-D demonstrations using correspondence features and hand-object interaction priors.
papers.summary_zh: 利用对应特征与手物交互先验，从RGB-D示范学习物体中心灵巧技能。

papers.title: ResMerge: Residual Policy Learning and Merging for Continual Adaptation of Pre-trained Robot Policies
papers.summary_en: Residual RL adapts a frozen base; residual-field consistency selects compatible LoRA experts for merging.
papers.summary_zh: 残差RL适应冻结基座，一致性筛选可合并LoRA专家。

papers.title: Continual Reinforcement Learning Is an Integration Problem
papers.summary_en: Organizes continual RL around ten system desiderata and proposes testing their coexistence within one persistent lifetime.
papers.summary_zh: 用十项系统要求组织持续强化学习，建议在同一持续生命周期内检验这些能力是否共存。

papers.title: Online Learning of Heterogeneous Locomotion Dynamics under Reinforcement Learning Policies for Precise Loco-Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Learns dynamics under frozen locomotion policy via contaminated-Gaussian weighting and random-feature GPs.
papers.summary_zh: 污染高斯与随机特征GP学习冻结行走策略动力学。

papers.title: Towards Understanding the Impact of Plasticity Loss on Reinforcement Learning in Stochastic Environments
papers.summary_en: Studies how observation/action noise interacts with SAC plasticity interventions, separating gradual learning-capacity loss from unstable TD updates.
papers.summary_zh: 研究观测／动作噪声与SAC可塑性干预的交互，区分渐进学习能力丧失和TD更新失稳。

papers.title: From Teleoperation to Long-Horizon Dexterity: Evaluating Visuomotor Skills and Offline Proxies for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Real-robot ablations examine representation choices and whether offline metrics predict dexterous insertion performance.
papers.summary_zh: 通过真机消融研究表示选择，以及离线指标能否预测灵巧插接效果。

papers.title: Contact Imitation Interface: Transferring Dexterous Skills by Showing How Contact Unfolds
papers.summary_en: CIMI transfers demonstrations through matched contact geometry, fingertip views and hierarchical contact-surface planning/control.
papers.summary_zh: CIMI通过匹配接触几何、指尖视角及分层接触面规划控制迁移示范。

papers.title: RTPolicy: Real-Time (32.9 Hz) Multi-View Visuomotor Policy for Robotic Manipulation on Edge Devices
papers.summary_en: View-aware fusion and compact tokens condition flow-matching actions.
papers.summary_zh: 视角融合、压缩token支持流匹配动作。

papers.title: Direct Action-Manifold Modeling for Efficient and Robust Bimanual Manipulation
papers.summary_en: DMAT predicts clean action chunks with local 3D geometry and spectral refinement.
papers.summary_zh: DMAT以局部三维与频谱修正预测动作块。

papers.title: Shared Modular Recurrence in Contextual MDPs for Universal Morphology Control
papers.summary_en: v4 adds controls distinguishing shared recurrent memory from fixed recent observation windows and from simply spending more training time, strengthening the unseen-morphology generalization evidence.
papers.summary_zh: v4新增对照，区分共享递归记忆与固定近期观测窗口、以及额外训练时间的作用，强化未见形态泛化的证据。

papers.title: π-StepNFT: Wider Space Needs Finer Steps in Online RL for Flow-based VLAs
papers.summary_en: Substantive revision: adds critic-derived temporal-credit variants and CALVIN diagnostics, and replaces broad OOD-superiority claims with a narrower visual-shift result under a transparent shared-variant comparison protocol.
papers.summary_zh: 实质修订：新增基于评论家时序信用信号的变体和CALVIN诊断，并以透明的共同测试变体协议，将广泛的分布外优势主张收窄为视觉扰动优势。

papers.title: Specification-Aware Distribution Shaping for Robotics Foundation Models
papers.summary_en: Substantive revision broadens specification-constrained action-distribution evaluation from SPOC-only studies to three foundation models and two STL-policy synthesis methods, exposing task-success costs despite perfect simulated constraint satisfaction.
papers.summary_zh: 实质修订将约束动作分布评估从仅SPOC扩展至三种基础模型和两种STL策略合成方法，展示仿真约束完全满足背后的任务成功率代价。

papers.title: M*: Every Task Deserves Its Own Memory Harness
papers.summary_en: Reflective code evolution jointly searches memory schema, storage logic and instructions as executable Python programs.
papers.summary_zh: 通过反思式代码进化，联合搜索可执行Python记忆程序的结构、存储逻辑和指令。

papers.title: EvoMemBench: Benchmarking Agent Memory from a Self-Evolving Perspective
papers.summary_en: Evaluates 15 memory methods across within/cross-episode and knowledge/execution axes, including ALFWorld.
papers.summary_zh: 沿回合内/跨回合、知识/执行两轴评测15种记忆方法，含ALFWorld。

papers.title: TacO: Benchmarking Tactile Sensors for Object Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Substantive revision adds force-channel ablations and expanded sensor-repeatability tests, strengthening the distinction between task-relevant tactile information and sensor specification or material advantages.
papers.summary_zh: 实质修订新增力分量消融和扩展传感器重复性测试，更明确区分任务相关触觉信息与传感器规格或材料优势。

papers.title: NDPP-Grasp: Non-Differentiable Physical Plausibility Constraint-Guided Task-Oriented Dexterous Grasp Generation
papers.summary_en: v 2 adds a substantial supplementary evaluation, including physical dexterous grasp deployment, flow-matching integration and further control/lookahead ablations absent from v 1’s PDF.
papers.summary_zh: v2加入v1 PDF中没有的大量补充评测，包括真机灵巧抓取、流匹配模型集成，以及控制与前瞻策略的进一步消融。

papers.title: VEGA: Learning Navigation VLAs from In-the-Wild Egocentric Video with Geometric Trajectory Supervision
papers.summary_en: Substantive revision adds dynamic simulation, a fourth hardware scenario and geometry-bias/supervision ablations for video-trained navigation, while clarifying that baselines share an execution interface rather than their complete native navigation stacks.
papers.summary_zh: 实质修订为视频训练导航新增动态仿真、第四个真机场景以及几何偏差/监督消融，并澄清基线共用执行接口，而非完整原生导航系统对比。

papers.title: Sequential Planning via Anchored Robotic Keypoints
papers.summary_en: Anchored keypoints support sequential robot plans with explicit execution interfaces.
papers.summary_zh: 锚定关键点支持具有明确执行接口的顺序机器人规划。

papers.title: Decompose and Reorganize: Planning with Primitives and Visuomotor Policies Learned from Demonstrations
papers.summary_en: v 2 extends DR-LfD evaluation with a fourth end-to-end real-world task, confidence intervals, data-scaling comparisons and more direct tests against generic TAMP grasp replacements.
papers.summary_zh: v2扩展DR-LfD评测，新增第四项端到端真机任务、置信区间、数据规模比较，以及替换为通用TAMP抓取模块的直接测试。

papers.title: UniCross: Unified Cross-Skill Dexterous Manipulation Synthesis
papers.summary_en: Substantive revision adds harder quantitative unseen-object and unseen-target evaluations, plus an expert-switching comparison that separates the shared formulation's compatibility from benefits of single-policy distillation.
papers.summary_zh: 实质修订新增更困难的未见物体和未见目标定量测试，并以专家切换对照区分统一任务表述的技能兼容性与单策略蒸馏本身的收益。

papers.title: HOPE: Hand-Object Pressure Estimation from Monocular Videos
papers.summary_en: Predicts hand-vertex normal pressure and contact from video. Substantive v2 adds measured near-bare-hand transfer and vertex-versus-parameter-token ablation.
papers.summary_zh: 从视频预测手部顶点法向压力与接触。v2实质新增近裸手传感器迁移评测及顶点/参数token对比。

papers.title: Detect and Suppress: A Mechanistic Defense against Adversarial Patches in VLA Models
papers.summary_en: v 2 corrects appendix probe diagnostics and qualifies intervention-strength tuning rather than introducing a new defense.
papers.summary_zh: v2修正附录探针诊断数据并补充干预强度调参说明，并非提出新防御方法。

papers.title: Self-Building Labs
papers.summary_en: v 2 expands the self-building-lab case study from the original quantum-dot workflow with HPLC plate loading and an expert-supervised RoboChem-Flex flow-photochemistry deployment, including held-out transport prediction.
papers.summary_zh: v2在原有量子点流程基础上新增HPLC样品板装载及专家监督下的RoboChem-Flex流动光化学部署，并提供留出条件下的输运预测验证。

papers.title: Learning from Fleet Experience: Collective Experience Learning Across 96 Robots
papers.summary_en: v 3 corrects the fleet data path: complete operator-labeled episodes are accumulated locally and transferred once, replacing v 2’s description of streaming trajectory fields and reusing inference observations in the cloud.
papers.summary_zh: v3修正机器人群数据通路：在本地积累完整、经操作员标注的回合，再一次性传输；不再沿用v2所述的轨迹字段流式上传与云端复用推理观测。

papers.title: Do Earth-Trained Humanoid Controllers Walk on the Moon? Gravity, Terrain, and Soil Transfer
papers.summary_en: v 2 strengthens and narrows the transfer analysis with a gravity-randomized rough-terrain policy trained without soil, time-to-fall diagnostics, and an explicit audit of claims across seeds.
papers.summary_zh: v2新增不使用土壤训练的重力随机化粗糙地形对照、跌倒时间分析，以及跨随机种子的结论审计，强化并收窄迁移结论。

papers.title: Mage-VL-Cowork: A Full Training Recipe to Learn Hybrid Computer Use From Evolved Harnesses
papers.summary_en: Distills evolved GUI/code teacher harnesses into a 4B computer-use policy through a five-stage training curriculum.
papers.summary_zh: 通过五阶段训练，把进化的GUI/代码教师harness蒸馏至4B电脑操作策略。

papers.title: Beyond Plausible Prediction: Safety Sufficiency in Web World Models
papers.summary_en: SafeWebWorld separates plausible predicted futures, preservation of policy-decisive evidence, and EXECUTE/ASK/BLOCK authorization.
papers.summary_zh: SafeWebWorld区分预测未来的合理性、决策关键证据保留和执行/询问/阻止授权判断。

papers.title: Frozen in Time: How a Physics Foundation Model Forgets Under Sim-to-Real Adaptation
papers.summary_en: Studies forgetting when Walrus-1.3B moves from PDE pretraining to cylinder simulation and real experimental flow.
papers.summary_zh: 研究Walrus-1.3B从PDE预训练转向圆柱流仿真及真实流体实验时的遗忘。

papers.title: Cyclical Entropy Eruption: Entropy Dynamics of Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary_en: v2 adds multi-seed validation of SEAL’s representation-separation auxiliary loss for stabilizing agent RL; the core entropy-eruption account and original benchmark tables were already in v1.
papers.summary_zh: v2新增SEAL表征分离辅助损失的多种子验证，用于稳定智能体强化学习；核心熵周期性喷发解释与原始基准表格已存在于v1。

papers.title: Energy-Based Policy Orchestration
papers.summary_en: EPO chooses and refines a policy–goal pair using policy-specific feasibility and tracking energies; new specialists need only their own energy models.
papers.summary_zh: EPO用策略专属可行性与跟踪能量选择并细化策略—目标对；添加专家只需训练其能量模型。

papers.title: Sequential Recovery Updates for Learned Controllers under Successful-Trajectory Preservation
papers.summary_en: Sequential recovery updates constrain skill-entry rules to preserve previously successful trajectories instead of relying only on frozen parameters.
papers.summary_zh: 顺序恢复更新约束技能入口以保留既有成功轨迹，而不只冻结参数。

papers.title: W2A: Distilling World Priors into Action Models for Real-Time Robotic Control
papers.summary_en: W2A distills compressed video-denoising features into an action policy and removes the video model at inference.
papers.summary_zh: W2A把压缩视频去噪特征蒸馏进动作策略，推理时移除视频模型。

papers.title: MAPO: Mixture of Experts with Alternating Policy Optimization for Universal Humanoid Motion Tracking
papers.summary_en: MAPO alternates router and expert updates to improve divergence estimation in mixture-of-experts policy optimization.
papers.summary_zh: MAPO交替优化路由与专家，改善混合专家策略梯度中的散度估计。

papers.title: DexArena: A Unified Benchmark for Long-Horizon Dexterous Manipulation
papers.summary_en: DexArena standardizes staged, long-horizon bimanual dexterous tasks and demonstrations.
papers.summary_zh: DexArena统一分阶段长程双臂灵巧操作任务与示范。

papers.title: HeLM: Hierarchical Explicit Language Memory for Non-Markovian Manipulation
papers.summary_en: HeLM maintains event-triggered, explicit language memory across subtasks and episodes above a shared π0 action policy.
papers.summary_zh: HeLM在共享π0动作策略之上维护事件触发语言记忆，贯穿子任务与回合。

papers.title: Visuo-tactile Diffusion Policy for Robotic Manipulation with Auxiliary Tactile Dynamics Prediction
papers.summary_en: A visuotactile diffusion policy adds training-only tactile-dynamics prediction to four-step multimodal histories.
papers.summary_zh: 视触觉扩散策略在四步多模态历史上加入仅训练时使用的触觉动力学预测。

papers.title: Closing the Dynamics Gap through Self-Directed Robotic Interaction
papers.summary_en: CUE autonomously reconstructs a billiards scene, builds tracking tools, and selects interactions to identify poorly modeled dynamics without resets.
papers.summary_zh: CUE自主重建台球场景、构建跟踪工具，并在无重置条件下选择交互辨识薄弱动力学。

papers.title: Right Ranking, Wrong Scale: Reproducing the Robotic World Model's Dynamics Model and Testing the Uncertainty of Its Follow-up
papers.summary_en: A reproduction audits RWM dynamics and the uncertainty calibration used by RWM-U.
papers.summary_zh: 复现实验审计RWM动力学及RWM-U的不确定性校准。

papers.title: Beyond Policy Patches: Distilling RL Specialists into Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.summary_en: REPAIR uses value-weighted specialist action distributions and on-policy state coverage to distill RL specialists into one flow-matching VLA.
papers.summary_zh: REPAIR用价值加权专家动作分布与在线策略状态覆盖，将RL专家蒸馏进单一流匹配VLA。

papers.title: SomaAlign: Reliability-Aware Multimodal Representation Learning for Soft Robotic Grasping
papers.summary_en: SomaAlign learns reliability-aware representations from multimodal soft-grasp sensing and tests frozen-encoder transfer.
papers.summary_zh: SomaAlign从软抓取多模态传感学习可靠性感知表征，并测试冻结编码器迁移。

papers.title: ReGATE: Recurrent Gated Visual Fusion for Reactive Humanoid-Object Interaction
papers.summary_en: ReGATE fuses depth and proprioception through recurrent gates for humanoid grasp–transport–release control.
papers.summary_zh: ReGATE通过循环门融合深度与本体感知，控制人形抓取—搬运—释放。

papers.title: PointPilot: Unified Robotic Manipulation via Object-Centric 3D Point Flow Prediction
papers.summary_en: PointPilot predicts object-centric 3D point flow for grounding, subtask planning and action execution without a separately trained action expert.
papers.summary_zh: PointPilot预测物体中心三维点流，联合定位、子任务规划与执行，无需单独训练动作专家。

papers.title: ReContact: Reconstruct and Retarget Human Contacts from Video for Contact-Rich Humanoid Manipulation
papers.summary_en: An object-centric contact plan stabilizes occluded reconstruction and rewards residual control for anchor and force-direction agreement.
papers.summary_zh: 物体中心接触计划稳定遮挡下重建，并以锚点和力方向一致性奖励残差控制。

papers.title: BeyondContact: A Reinforcement Learning Framework for Airflow-Based Non-Contact Manipulation
papers.summary_en: BeyondContact adds identified airflow physics to Isaac Lab and learns hybrid pushing/blowing and airflow-only reorientation policies.
papers.summary_zh: BeyondContact向Isaac Lab加入辨识气流物理，学习推吹混合及纯气流转向策略。

papers.title: VLALagBench: Understanding When and Why VLA Inference Latency Matters
papers.summary_en: VLALagBench varies object speeds, task demands and synchronous/asynchronous execution to characterize VLA latency sensitivity.
papers.summary_zh: VLALagBench改变物体速度、任务需求及同步/异步执行，刻画VLA延迟敏感性。

papers.title: FineCraft: Enhancing VLA Models for Fine-Grained Manipulation
papers.summary_en: FineCraft routes tasks among independently adapted DINOv2-DiT and π0.5 policies with local visual features and expert continuations.
papers.summary_zh: FineCraft在独立适配DINOv2-DiT与π0.5策略间路由任务，结合局部视觉及专家延续示范。

papers.title: VerifLM: Physically Verified Image-Edit-Guided Goal Pose Generation for Robotic Manipulation
papers.summary_en: VerifLM converts edited-image goals to physically checked 6-DoF object poses with multiple hypothetical geometry–physics worlds.
papers.summary_zh: VerifLM把编辑图像目标转为经多种假设几何—物理世界检验的六自由度物体位姿。

papers.title: ForceLDM: A Force-aware Latent Dynamics Model for Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.summary_en: ForceLDM distills privileged future force/torque and optical-flow dynamics into a current-observation student.
papers.summary_zh: ForceLDM将特权未来力/力矩及光流动力学蒸馏到只读当前观测的学生。

papers.title: When Robots Outweigh Objects: How Inertia Mismatch Shapes Robot Policy Learning
papers.summary_en: Controlled mass and reflected-inertia experiments study how robot–object inertia mismatch affects policy learning.
papers.summary_zh: 受控质量与反射惯量实验研究机器人—物体惯量失配对策略学习的影响。

papers.title: PanoTac: A Dense Three-Axis Tactile Sensor for Robust Touch-Centric Manipulation
papers.summary_en: PanoTac supplies dense normal and shear sensing for learned contact-rich manipulation.
papers.summary_zh: PanoTac为学习型接触操作提供稠密法向及剪切感知。

papers.title: TAMPAgent: Agentic Belief-Space Planning for Mobile Manipulation
papers.summary_en: TAMPAgent couples an LVLM with belief-space task-and-motion constraints, interleaving observation and action under partial observability.
papers.summary_zh: TAMPAgent把LVLM与信念空间任务运动约束结合，在部分可观测条件下交替观察与行动。

papers.title: Pixel-UMI: Learning Environment-Aware Whole-Body Manipulation from Sensorized Human Demonstrations
papers.summary_en: Pixel-UMI combines geometry-aware human demonstration retargeting, view masking and on-policy DAgger corrections.
papers.summary_zh: Pixel-UMI结合几何感知人类示范重定向、视角掩码与在线DAgger纠正。

papers.title: Pixel: A Co-Designed Full-Stack Robot System for Learning General-Purpose Mobile Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Pixel co-designs wheeled-humanoid hardware, demonstration interfaces, whole-body control and hierarchical policy learning.
papers.summary_zh: Pixel联合设计轮式人形硬件、示范接口、全身控制与分层策略学习。

papers.title: CalVLA: Shaping Native Confidence in Vision-Language-Action Policies with Outcome Supervision
papers.summary_en: CalVLA trains OpenVLA action-token confidence using successful and failed rollout outcomes without a separate failure detector.
papers.summary_zh: CalVLA用成功/失败rollout结果训练OpenVLA动作token置信度，无单独失败检测器。

papers.title: Beyond Validation Loss: Coverage and Reliability Dynamics in Robot Policy Pretraining
papers.summary_en: Closed-loop pass@k separates reliability at one rollout from reachable-success coverage under repeated sampling during policy pretraining.
papers.summary_zh: 闭环pass@k区分单次可靠性与重复采样可达成功覆盖，用于策略预训练评估。

papers.title: UA-Depth: Uncertainty-Aware Depth Restoration for Material-Agnostic Object Manipulation
papers.summary_en: UA-Depth jointly restores metric depth and uncertainty for difficult transparent and reflective materials.
papers.summary_zh: UA-Depth联合恢复困难透明/反光材质的度量深度及不确定性。

papers.title: Gibbs Variational Last Layers for Long-Horizon Dynamics Learning
papers.summary_en: Gibbs variational last layers introduce multistep, CRPS-based and autoregressive training objectives for probabilistic dynamics.
papers.summary_zh: Gibbs变分末层引入多步、CRPS及自回归训练目标，学习概率动力学。

papers.title: Seeing Through the Illusion: Test-Time Scaling for World Action Models
papers.summary_en: Freeze a WAM, sample four world-action rollouts and select using action validity and temporal regularity, inverse-dynamics consistency, and instruction-conditioned progress.
papers.summary_zh: 冻结世界动作模型，每步采样4条世界-动作轨迹，以动作有效性和时间正则、逆动力学一致性及指令条件进度联合选取。

papers.title: D&A: Decoupling Description and Assessment Enables VLMs as Zero-Shot Robotic Reward Models
papers.summary_en: Prompt a VLM to describe video dynamics and then assess progress against explicit success criteria, producing progress and language feedback without reward-model training.
papers.summary_zh: 通过提示让视觉语言模型先描述视频动态，再依据显式成功标准评估进度，无需训练奖励模型，可输出进度和语言反馈。

papers.title: Rollout then Recycle: 3,718 Labelled Real-Robot Episodes from Benchmarking 7 Policies on 12 Tasks
papers.summary_en: Releases a real-robot corpus combining teleoperation demonstrations and labelled rollouts of seven imitation-learning and VLA policies on common tasks.
papers.summary_zh: 公开真机数据集，汇集遥操作演示和七种模仿学习/VLA 策略在共同任务上的标注执行轨迹。

papers.title: KlaskTron-IL: A Contact-Rich Adversarial Imitation Learning Benchmark with a Validated Sim-to-Real Bridge
papers.summary_en: Provides a multi-tier imitation-learning dataset and diagnostic baselines for a physical two-player adversarial platform.
papers.summary_zh: 为双人对抗真机平台提供分层模仿学习数据集与诊断基线。

papers.title: KlaskTron: An Open-Source Platform for Physical Adversarial Multi-Agent RL
papers.summary_en: Open-source desktop adversarial robotics platform with a GPU-native Isaac Lab digital twin and learned actuator model.
papers.summary_zh: 开源桌面对抗机器人平台，提供 Isaac Lab 数字孪生和学习式执行器模型。

papers.title: OmniPiano: Diverse Dexterous Piano-Playing Challenges for Standard, Robust, Safe, and Multi-Agent RL
papers.summary_en: OmniPiano unifies standard, robust, safe, and cooperative RL for dexterous piano playing with one to five Shadow Hands.
papers.summary_zh: OmniPiano用1至5只Shadow Hand统一灵巧钢琴演奏的标准、鲁棒、安全及协作强化学习。

papers.title: Exo: An Architecture for Self-Improving Systems at Runtime
papers.summary_en: Exo lets an agent revise its runtime harness during ongoing tasks while a protected mechanism retains history and governs policy activation.
papers.summary_zh: Exo允许智能体在任务执行中修改运行框架，由受保护机制保留历史并管理新策略启用。

papers.title: Skill++: Towards Lifelong Agents via Routing-Aware Skill Refinement
