papers.summary_en: Skill++ treats a growing skill library as continual routing: rewrite incoming skill names/descriptions to clarify capabilities, distinctions, and exclusions, without retraining the router.
papers.summary_zh: Skill++将技能库增长视为持续路由问题，只重写新技能名称和描述，说明能力、差异及排除项，不重训路由器。

papers.title: Editing the Goal: Per-Token SAE Steering and Its Depth Limits in π0.5
papers.summary_en: Swapping SAE features at a single goal word can redirect π0.5-LIBERO without changing the instruction text; activation patching maps the depth at which goal information remains editable.
papers.summary_zh: 保持指令文本不变，交换单个目标词的SAE特征即可重定向π0.5-LIBERO，并用激活替换定位目标信息可编辑的层深。

papers.title: Can Jev Improve Demonstration Retrieval for In-Context Learning?
papers.summary_en: Uses Jev probabilistic utility judgments to rank in-context demonstrations, then distills them into an inexpensive MLP retriever.
papers.summary_zh: 用Jev概率效用判断排序上下文示例，再蒸馏至低成本MLP检索器。

papers.title: Leap-VLA: High-Rate Robot Control from a Low-Rate VLM Backbone
papers.summary_en: Leap-VLA decouples a slow semantic VLM from a fast visual action expert and explicitly conditions/trains on semantic-cache age.
papers.summary_zh: Leap-VLA将低频语义VLM与高频视觉动作专家解耦，并显式以语义缓存年龄作为条件与训练变量。

papers.title: Learning by Doing: Autonomously Compiling and Curating Agent Skills from Verified Traces
papers.summary_en: Zep Agent Skills compiles verified execution traces into versioned procedural skills, with separate reflection, curation, admission, and retrieval ranking.
papers.summary_zh: Zep Agent Skills将已验证执行轨迹编译为版本化程序技能，分离反思、整理、准入及检索排序。

papers.title: Just-in-Time Skill Retrieval via Long-Horizon State Tracking
papers.summary_en: JitSkill retrieves skills during execution using a continually updated task state rather than fixing a skill set from the initial instruction.
papers.summary_zh: JitSkill根据持续更新的任务状态在执行过程中检索技能，而非仅由初始指令固定技能集合。

papers.title: Delivered, Not Used: Evaluating Agent Memory at Its Point of Use
papers.summary_en: MemUse audits delivered memory at its point of use, linking relevance, novelty, influence, and observed consequences to trajectory evidence.
papers.summary_zh: MemUse在记忆实际交付和使用的位置审计相关性、新颖性、影响及可见后果，并关联轨迹证据。

papers.title: Cumulative and Audited Guardrail Tool Evolution for LLM Agent Safety
papers.summary_en: EVOLVE accumulates executable guardrail tools, audits inherited rules, and revises them as new risks emerge.
papers.summary_zh: EVOLVE累积可执行安全检查工具，审计继承规则，并随新风险出现修订。

papers.title: SelfImprove-Bench: Evaluating Generalization in Self-Improving Agents
papers.summary_en: SelfImprove-Bench separates self-improvement into exploring, planning, and reasoning games and proposes a G0–G4 generalization ladder.
papers.summary_zh: SelfImprove-Bench以探索、规划及推理游戏区分自改进能力，提出G0–G4泛化阶梯。

papers.title: Top-$k$ Retrieval Leaves Memory Value Undetermined
papers.summary_en: LEDGER asks which memory values are identifiable from retrieval logs, using retrieval and co-retrieval counts, and explicitly marks others undetermined.
papers.summary_zh: LEDGER根据检索与共同检索计数判断哪些记忆价值能从日志中识别，对其余明确标注未确定。

papers.title: Ripple: Deadline-Aware CPU-GPU Sharing for Embodied Inference
papers.summary_en: Ripple schedules pausable GPU inference against CPU deadlines on unified-memory edge devices using model-derived traffic estimates and completion feedback.
papers.summary_zh: Ripple在统一内存边缘设备上以模型推算流量与完成反馈协调可暂停GPU推理和CPU截止期。

papers.title: World Models Need Not Be Right to Rank Policies Right: Relative Bounds and Audit Limits
papers.summary_en: RAVEL distinguishes accurate policy ranking inside a learned world model from informative paired real-environment audits.
papers.summary_zh: RAVEL区分世界模型内策略排序准确与成对真实环境审计是否提供有效信息。

papers.title: Evolving Memory, Learning to Meta-Control: Test-Time Adaptation for Experience-augmented LLM Agents
papers.summary_en: OMCE jointly evolves experience memory and an online contextual-bandit controller selecting DIRECT, EPISODE, GUIDE, or DISTILL.
papers.summary_zh: OMCE同时演化经验记忆和在线上下文bandit控制器，在直接执行、回合经验、指导及蒸馏四种模式间选择。

papers.title: Value Forcing: Aligning Return Distributions at All Noise Levels
papers.summary_en: Value Forcing learns return distributions with flow matching while enforcing Bellman consistency at every noise level, instantiated as VF and IVF.
papers.summary_zh: Value Forcing以流匹配学习回报分布，并在所有噪声层级施加Bellman一致性，形成VF和IVF。

papers.title: ANCHOR: KL-Anchored Adaptation for Stable Offline-to-Online RL
papers.summary_en: ANCHOR stabilizes offline-to-online RL without offline replay by initially KL-anchoring the actor to its pretrained policy, then annealing this constraint.
papers.summary_zh: ANCHOR在不回放离线数据的离线转在线RL中，先以KL约束将actor锚定预训练策略，再逐步退火。

papers.title: Iterative Gumbel Planning for Continuous Control
papers.summary_en: Iterative Gumbel Planning aligns finite search candidates with a factorized categorical continuous-control policy and uses repeated Gumbel/MPPI-style refinement.
papers.summary_zh: Iterative Gumbel Planning以分维度类别策略匹配有限动作搜索候选，并迭代执行Gumbel/MPPI式精修。

papers.title: Can Coding Agents Sustain Continual Evolution without Forgetting?
papers.summary_en: Studies catastrophic forgetting when coding agents continually evolve their harness across different task types without changing base-model parameters.
papers.summary_zh: 研究代码智能体在不修改基础模型参数下跨任务类型持续演化harness时的灾难性遗忘。

papers.title: Compositional Self-Improvement: Promises and Pitfalls
papers.summary_en: Studies when composing solutions to simpler subproblems can provide reliable self-generated supervision for harder tasks.
papers.summary_zh: 研究何时可组合简单子问题解答，为更难任务提供可靠自生成监督。

papers.title: Agent Memory as Rate-Limited Filtering: Explicit State Outlasts Long Context Beyond a Reader-Dependent Horizon
papers.summary_en: Frames memory as recursive state filtering and tests whether explicit state preserves order-sensitive decisions better than reading a long event log.
papers.summary_zh: 将记忆视为递归状态滤波，测试显式状态是否比阅读长事件日志更能保留顺序敏感决策。

papers.title: A Universal Policy Wrapper With Guarantees
papers.summary_en: CALF-Wrapper chooses between a pretrained RL policy and a fallback controller using the learned critic, aiming to inherit goal-reaching guarantees.
papers.summary_zh: CALF-Wrapper利用已学习critic在预训练RL策略与备用控制器间选择，以继承目标到达保证。

papers.title: Finite-Memory Control of POMDPs: Fundamental Limits and Efficient Design
papers.summary_en: RECAP quantizes belief states using decision-relevant distinctions, with lower and upper bounds on finite-memory POMDP control loss.
papers.summary_zh: RECAP按决策相关差异量化信念状态，并给出有限记忆POMDP控制损失的上下界。

papers.title: Xiaomi Auto World Model 2.0: Causal World Models for Real-World Driving and Embodied Intelligence
papers.summary_en: A streaming multi-view world model combines view-temporal attention, explicit 3D Gaussian scene context, and gated linear attention. A robot WAM reuses the video DiT with a separate attention-sharing action expert.
papers.summary_zh: 流式多视角世界模型结合视图-时间注意力、显式3D高斯场景上下文及门控线性注意力；机器人WAM复用视频DiT并引入共享注意力的独立动作专家。

papers.title: Gnomon4D: Learning Where and When to Focus for Geometric Motion-Grounded World-Action Modeling
papers.summary_en: Jointly predicts RGB video, actions, and GeoDelta geometric motion; spatial interaction attention and transition-aware aggregation expose object–embodiment motion to control.
papers.summary_zh: 联合预测视频、动作与 GeoDelta 几何运动；以交互区域注意力和状态转折聚合，将物体与本体运动关系用于控制。

papers.title: AuroraWorld: Structured 4D World Modeling for Exo-to-Ego Video Generation in Robot Manipulation
papers.summary_en: AuroraWorld converts exocentric robot video into egocentric training views using structured4D modeling; v2 materially changes the evaluation presentation and baseline protocol.
papers.summary_zh: AuroraWorld用结构化4D建模将外视角机器人视频转换为第一视角训练数据；v2实质修改评测呈现与基线协议。

papers.title: EgoActionBench: Benchmarking Dense Action Captioning for Egocentric Human Videos
papers.summary_en: Benchmarks dense, temporally localized egocentric manipulation captions with left/right/both-hand assignments and semantic plus temporal scoring.
papers.summary_zh: 评估第一视角操作视频的密集原子动作描述，结合时间定位、左右/双手归属及语义与时序评分。

papers.title: Can Large Language Model Agents Learn by Watching Tutorial Videos?
papers.summary_en: Tutorial Agentic Learning builds persistent tutorialbook memory through adversarial question harvesting and refinement, with reasoning-driven table-of-contents retrieval and no parameter updates.
papers.summary_zh: TAL通过对抗式问题挖掘与修订形成持久tutorialbook记忆，以推理驱动目录检索，不更新模型参数。

papers.title: Old Is Not False: Valid-Time Memory for Interactive Video World Models
papers.summary_en: ReDate separates capture time from state-valid time in visual memory, using the action log to re-date retrieved tokens after actions are undone without training the generator.
papers.summary_zh: ReDate区分图像拍摄时间与状态有效时间，在撤销动作后利用动作日志重标检索token时间，不训练生成器。

papers.title: FORCE: Factorized Object Relations for Counterfactual Editing in Video World Models
papers.summary_en: FORCE factorizes object-pair interaction latents for persistent removal, modification, transfer or introduction of relations in video world models.
papers.summary_zh: FORCE把物体对交互分解成显式潜变量，支持持续删除、修改、迁移或引入关系。

papers.title: Spoofing the Latent State: Imperceptible Goal-Image Attacks Derail Planning in LeWorldModel
papers.summary_en: Audits robustness of LeWorldModel latent-distance planning to small goal-image and observation perturbations.
papers.summary_zh: 审计LeWorldModel潜空间距离规划对微小目标图像和观测扰动的稳健性。

papers.title: RSI-Env: An Open-Ended Environment for Recursive Self-Improvement of Agents
papers.summary_en: RSI-Env preserves research state and lets accepted model–harness versions conduct subsequent self-improvement, separating open goals, capability-directed goals and benchmark guidance.
papers.summary_zh: RSI-Env保留研究状态，让被接受的模型–harness版本继续自我改进，并区分开放目标、能力定向和基准反馈设置。

papers.title: When Does Latent Prediction Error Support Physical Surprise Claims in Video World Models?
papers.summary_en: Distinguishes physical information in learned representations from whether a world model’s native prediction error is a reliable physical-surprise score.
papers.summary_zh: 区分表征包含物理信息与世界模型原生预测误差能否可靠量化物理惊讶。

papers.title: Toward Counterfactual Learning for Selective Re-Examination in Agentic Visual Search
papers.summary_en: CARE gives localized RL credit to commit-versus-reinspect decisions using cost-aware paired continuations from the same visual-search state; ReSee labels the value of additional observation.
papers.summary_zh: CARE从同一视觉搜索状态的成对续程估计带成本反事实收益，将RL信用分配给提交/重看决策；ReSee标注额外观察价值。

papers.title: TriPhysBench: Evaluating Physical Intelligence for Embodied Agents
papers.summary_en: TriPhysBench tests coordinated physical perception, external knowledge retrieval and quantitative reasoning, with a tool-trajectory-trained TriPhys policy.
papers.summary_zh: TriPhysBench联合评估物理感知、外部知识检索与定量推理，并训练基于工具轨迹的TriPhys策略。

papers.title: History Forcing: Distilling History-Dependent Continuations for Long-Horizon Video World Models
papers.summary_en: History Forcing distills the residual between teacher predictions with and without informative history into few-step autoregressive video generation, including out-of-sight continuations.
papers.summary_zh: History Forcing将教师有/无有效历史预测的残差蒸馏进少步自回归视频生成，包括离开视野后的状态延续。

papers.title: SparseWAM: Driving World-Action Models are Worth 16 Register Tokens
papers.summary_en: SparseWAM predicts future states in 16 register tokens per frame and conditions trajectory tokens on imagined registers at deployment, retaining world-model inference while reducing cost.
papers.summary_zh: SparseWAM以每帧16个register token预测未来状态，部署时轨迹token仍读取想象状态，以降低世界模型推理成本。

papers.title: Reconstruction as Spatial Evaluation: Diagnosing Cross-View Spatial Intelligence in Large Vision-Language Models
papers.summary_en: RECONSPATIAL asks models to reconstruct queried objects as oriented 3D boxes in a shared metric camera frame, separating relational structure from metric placement.
papers.summary_zh: RECONSPATIAL要求模型在共同相机米制坐标系重建目标物体的定向3D框，分开衡量相对结构和绝对尺度/位置。

papers.title: Learning to Live: A Step Toward Lifelong Embodied Intelligence
papers.summary_en: LIFE integrates continuous robot perception, memory and action; this revision corrects the RoboBeats memory evaluation and comparator provenance.
papers.summary_zh: LIFE整合持续机器人感知、记忆和行动；本次修订更新RoboBeats记忆评测与基线来源。

papers.title: Anchor 1: Precise and Stable Humanoid Control for Whole-Body Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Anchor 1 uses calibrated sparse references, curated motions and explicit tracking-error feedback for stable humanoid manipulation.
papers.summary_zh: Anchor 1用标定稀疏参考、筛选运动与显式误差反馈提升人形机器人操作稳定性。

papers.title: Does Validation Loss Predict Real-Robot Success? Evidence from Four Imitation-Learning Policies on a Low-Cost Arm
papers.summary_en: An SO-101 study tests whether offline imitation-learning losses predict real deployment success.
papers.summary_zh: SO-101研究检查模仿学习离线损失能否预测真机成功。

papers.title: Teach, Abstract, Apply: A Framework for Dialogue-Driven Task Learning with Collaborative Robots
papers.summary_en: Teach-Abstract-Apply turns dialogue-taught workflows into reusable executable skills.
papers.summary_zh: Teach-Abstract-Apply把对话教授的流程抽象为可复用可执行技能。

papers.title: SPARK: Self-Correcting Embodied Memory via Physical Re-Observation
papers.summary_en: SPARK uses a semantic critic, targeted physical revisits and selective merging to correct multi-episode embodied memory.
papers.summary_zh: SPARK通过语义critic、针对性重访与选择性合并修正跨回合具身记忆。

papers.title: Behavior Graphs: Unsupervised Graph Structures for Interpreting Robot Deployment Data
papers.summary_en: Behavior graphs summarize deployment rollouts as behavioral modes, transitions and outcomes to support data-collection decisions.
papers.summary_zh: Behavior graphs把部署轨迹压缩为行为模式、转移和结果，辅助后续数据采集。

papers.title: TacMind: Benchmarking and Modeling Tactile Interaction States for Robotic Manipulation
papers.summary_en: TacMind learns action-conditioned tactile latent dynamics and uses predicted tactile states to refine manipulation actions.
papers.summary_zh: TacMind学习动作条件触觉潜在动力学，并用预测触觉状态修正操作动作。

papers.title: WorldSketch: Sketching World Models for Zero-Shot Mobile Manipulation
papers.summary_en: WorldSketch makes the VLM construct and validate a minimal kinematic world model, then plans contact and whole-body motion on it.
papers.summary_zh: WorldSketch让VLM构造并验证最小运动学世界模型，再在其上规划接触与全身运动。

papers.title: Behavioral Steering of Vision-Language-Action Models in the Low-Parameter Regime
papers.summary_en: TinyLoRA steers frozen OpenVLA-OFT behavior with 8–384 trainable parameters using GRPO or CMA-ES.
papers.summary_zh: TinyLoRA通过GRPO或CMA-ES，仅用8–384个可训练参数调整冻结OpenVLA-OFT行为。

papers.title: Reflex: Fast Robot Policy Serving by Reusing and Correcting Past Actions
papers.summary_en: Reflex caches complete action chunks, corrects them with action-aware similarity and residuals, and refreshes the policy according to progress.
papers.summary_zh: Reflex缓存完整动作块，以动作相似度和残差修正，并按进度刷新原策略。

papers.title: Faster Imitation by Re-timing Demonstrations Within the Controller Limit
papers.summary_en: Controller-bounded demonstration re-timing merges commands only when their summed displacement remains realizable.
papers.summary_zh: 控制器约束示范重定时仅在合并位移可实现时合并指令。

papers.title: Roz: A Taste Test for World Model Latents
papers.summary_en: Roz probes physical information in world-model latents using contrastive and continuous scenarios rather than a learned planner.
papers.summary_zh: Roz用对比与连续场景探查世界模型latent的物理信息，避免依赖学习规划器。

papers.title: Learning from an Imitable Teacher: Competition Solution for the MetaFine Challenge
papers.summary_en: A MetaFine competition solution makes privileged teachers easier for memoryless students to imitate, using failure correction and task-specific policies.
papers.summary_zh: MetaFine方案通过失败纠正和任务专用策略，让特权教师更适于无记忆学生模仿。

papers.title: PREM: Prediction-Regulated Memory for Robot Manipulation
papers.summary_en: PREM trains recurrent visual memory with action-conditioned prediction and gates spatial updates using prediction discrepancy.
papers.summary_zh: PREM用动作条件预测训练循环视觉记忆，并以预测差异调节空间更新。

papers.title: MOST: Memory of Object States and Task Progress for Long-Horizon Mobile Manipulation
papers.summary_en: MOST supervises internal historical and predictive tokens with object-state changes and subtask progress.
papers.summary_zh: MOST以物体状态变化与子任务进度监督内部历史和预测token。

papers.title: Verifying Test-State Identity in Paired Evaluation of Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.summary_en: A provenance checker tests whether paired VLA evaluation actually assigns identical initial states under vectorized reset behavior.
papers.summary_zh: 溯源检查器验证向量化重置下配对VLA评估是否实际分配相同初始状态。

papers.title: Why Koopman Structure Does Not Help Differentiable World Models for Humanoid Whole-Body Tracking
papers.summary_en: Negative study comparing bilinear Koopman and MLP world models for learning simulated G1 motion tracking through imagined-rollout gradients.
papers.summary_zh: 在仿真 G1 动作跟踪中，对比用想象轨迹梯度训练的双线性 Koopman 与 MLP 世界模型。

papers.title: Task-Specialized Language-Conditioned Models for Fine-Grained Robotic Manipulation
papers.summary_en: A MetaFine entry combines frozen DINOv2/CLIP encoders with task-specific language-conditioned action heads and demonstration correction.
papers.summary_zh: MetaFine方案结合冻结DINOv2/CLIP、任务专用语言条件动作头及示范纠正。

papers.title: Evaluating Tactile Foundation Models for End-to-End Imitation Learning in Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Multiple pretrained tactile encoders are integrated into Diffusion Policy under common settings, testing fine-tuning and task-specific mid-training.
papers.summary_zh: 在共同设置下将多种预训练触觉编码器集成到Diffusion Policy，比较微调和任务中训练。

papers.title: Generalizable robotic manipulation through compositional skill reuse
papers.summary_en: SHARE composes reusable closed-loop skills over perception, planning and control, with one language-model task-specification call per trial.
papers.summary_zh: SHARE在感知、规划和控制上组合可复用闭环技能，每次试验仅调用一次语言模型生成任务说明。

papers.title: pico-WAM: Evaluating Counterfactual Prediction and Planning Error in a Compact World Action Model
papers.summary_en: pico-WAM intervenes separately on proposal generation and trajectory scoring to diagnose compact world-action planning.
papers.summary_zh: pico-WAM分别干预提案生成与轨迹评分，诊断紧凑世界动作规划。

papers.title: Auriga Technical Report: A Task-Agnostic Agent Harness for Zero-Shot Embodied Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Auriga provides a calibrated 3D, dual-arm agent harness with trajectory previews, stage checks and in-place recovery.
papers.summary_zh: Auriga提供标定3D、双臂Agent harness，含轨迹预览、阶段检查和原地恢复。

papers.title: ClothDojo: Learned Data Generation and Benchmarking for Bimanual Garment Flattening and Folding
papers.summary_en: ClothDojo uses NOCS-assisted VLA data generation and appearance re-rendering to train RGB-only garment manipulation policies.
papers.summary_zh: ClothDojo利用NOCS辅助VLA生成数据并重渲染外观，训练纯RGB服装操作策略。

papers.title: Learning Agile Humanoid Dodgeball with Onboard Monocular Vision
papers.summary_en: A monocular humanoid dodgeball system combines temporal threat estimation with learned evasion, recovery and target-reacquisition policies.
papers.summary_zh: 单目人形躲避球系统将时序威胁估计与学习的躲避、恢复、目标重捕获策略组合。

papers.title: Vision-Language Models Are Joint Denoisers in Robotic Action Generation
papers.summary_en: JADE proposed joint VLM/action-expert denoising; its current arXiv record is withdrawn.
papers.summary_zh: JADE 曾提出 VLM 与动作专家联合去噪；当前 arXiv 记录已撤稿。

papers.title: Shades of Success: Evaluating Manipulation Quality from Object-Centric Constraints
papers.summary_en: SPECTRA learns object-centric pose constraints from oracle demonstrations and scores manipulation quality beyond binary success.
papers.summary_zh: SPECTRA从oracle示范学习物体中心位姿约束，评价二元成功之外的操作质量。

papers.title: Same Path, Less Time: Training-Free Fast Execution of Vision-Language-Action Models under Inference Latency
papers.summary_en: Path-preserving Time Scaling separates reference-path replanning from latency-aware execution rate for frozen chunking policies.
papers.summary_zh: Path-preserving Time Scaling分离参考路径重规划与延迟感知执行速度，用于冻结动作块策略。

papers.title: Serving Agentic Robot Fleets: Workload Characterization, KV-Cache Thrashing, and Admission Control
papers.summary_en: A serving study characterizes coupled brain KV-cache residency and VLA action deadlines for agentic robot fleets.
papers.summary_zh: 服务系统研究刻画机器人Agent群的brain KV缓存驻留与VLA动作deadline耦合。

papers.title: $TF^2$-Steering: Action Refinement with Tactile Forecasts and Feedback via Velocity-Field Steering
papers.summary_en: TF²-Steering uses forecast and observed tactile signals to steer the flow-matching action expert through a residual mixture of experts.
papers.summary_zh: TF²-Steering以预测及观测触觉通过残差专家混合调整flow-matching动作专家。

papers.title: Democratizing Robot-Use Agents: A Unified Harness with Open Models
papers.summary_en: An open-model robot-use harness supports tool-based manipulation and investigates capabilities behind effective robot use.
papers.summary_zh: 开放模型机器人使用框架支持工具式操控，并分析有效机器人使用所需的能力。

papers.title: Recursive Self-Improvement of Exoskeleton Assistance Policies through Human-in-the-Loop Feedback
papers.summary_en: An agent revises executable exoskeleton assistance code using subjective feedback, movement outcomes and muscle measurements.
papers.summary_zh: Agent依据主观反馈、运动结果和肌肉测量修订可执行外骨骼辅助代码。

papers.title: SCOUT: Planning under Occlusion via Object-Centric World Model Rollouts

papers.summary_zh: SCOUT结合物体中心遮挡重建、LLM提案与世界模型指导MCTS完成杂乱操作。

papers.title: HuG: Learning Humanoid Whole-Body Affordance-Aware Grasping with Active Perception

papers.summary_zh: HuG耦合主动视点选择、全身抓取可供性与控制器在环可行性过滤。

papers.title: ODE Policy: Robot Learning via Action Dynamics, Not Actions
papers.summary_en: ODE Policy learns action derivatives and integrates from the previous action, aiming for continuous control across imitation and RL.
papers.summary_zh: ODE Policy学习动作导数并从上一动作积分，面向模仿学习和RL连续控制。

papers.title: CompliantBot: Learning Whole-Body Compliance across Task Interfaces for Humanoid Control

papers.summary_zh: CompliantBot通过交互力场与负载相关奖励权重训练全身顺应与任务恢复。

papers.title: Answering Without Arriving: An Evidence Audit for Embodied Question Answering
papers.summary_en: An embodied-QA evidence ladder separates observation acquisition from text shortcuts and answer accuracy.
papers.summary_zh: 具身问答证据阶梯分离观测获取、文本捷径与答案正确率。

papers.title: Do Embodied VLMs Actually Use Their Scene-Graph Memory?

papers.summary_zh: 图交换测试检查VLM是否真正依赖输入场景图记忆。

papers.title: Back to the Future: Predicting Long-Horizon Dynamics with Retrospective Correction for Disturbance-Aware Retrieval
papers.summary_en: DARE retrospectively corrects earlier predicted object states and reruns relational dynamics to plan low-disturbance retrieval.
papers.summary_zh: DARE追溯修正先前预测物体状态、重跑关系动力学，规划低扰动取物。

papers.title: When Delay Meets Drift: Physical Safety of Robot Foundation Models Is a Cross-Layer Problem
papers.summary_en: A cross-layer safety study tests interactions between inference delay and camera-distribution shift in π0.5 closed-loop control.
papers.summary_zh: 跨层安全研究测试π0.5闭环控制中推理延迟与相机分布偏移的交互。

papers.title: GoalDex: Learning Image-Goal-Conditioned Policies for Dexterous In-Hand Manipulation

papers.title: Beyond Ensemble Disagreement: Predictive STL Monitoring of RL Locomotion under Distribution Shift
papers.summary_en: Predictive STL monitoring tests whether world-model rollouts and ensemble disagreement add useful safety ranking under locomotion shifts.
papers.summary_zh: 预测式STL监控检验世界模型rollout与集成分歧在运动分布偏移下能否增加安全排序价值。

papers.title: Late Autumn: LLM Agents Specialize a General Multi-Robot Planner for One Warehouse
papers.summary_en: Late Autumn studies coding agents specializing a lifelong multi-robot planner for a warehouse through scored, reviewable patches.
papers.summary_zh: Late Autumn研究编码Agent通过可评分、可审阅补丁为仓库特化终身多机器人规划器。

papers.title: RoboColosseum: Evaluating Physical Intelligence at Scale In-The-Wild
papers.summary_en: RoboColosseum combines blinded distributed physical comparison with fixed-data fine-tuning across four embodiments.
papers.summary_zh: RoboColosseum结合分布式盲测真机比较与固定数据微调，覆盖四种本体。

papers.title: MAESTRO: Orchestrating Robotics Modules with Coding Agents for Zero-Shot Generalist Robots
papers.summary_en: A coding-agent harness composes perception, planning and control modules, with outcome verification and code repair.
papers.summary_zh: 编码Agent通过harness组织感知、规划和控制工具，并验证结果、修复程序。

papers.title: CoEnv: Code-Driven Exploration in Real-to-Sim Digital Twins for Multi-Arm Manipulation
papers.summary_en: CoEx explores complete robot programs inside deployment-scene digital twins and transfers verified programs to hardware.

papers.title: RoboSnap: One-Shot Real-to-Sim Scene Generation for Generalizable Robot Learning and Evaluation
papers.summary_en: RoboSnap constructs simulation-ready scenes for replay, data generation and robot-policy evaluation.
papers.summary_zh: RoboSnap构建可仿真场景，支持轨迹回放、数据生成和策略评估。

papers.title: How to Peel with a Knife: Aligning Fine-Grained Manipulation with Human Preference
papers.summary_en: Force-aware imitation is refined with a reward combining peeling-thickness labels and expert preferences.
papers.summary_zh: 力感知模仿策略通过结合削皮厚度标签与专家偏好的奖励进一步优化。

papers.title: Robot-Factored World Models via Robot Rendering
papers.summary_en: Robot rendering separates commanded robot motion from learned scene dynamics in video prediction.
papers.summary_zh: 机器人渲染将指令机器人运动与学习的场景动态分开用于视频预测。

papers.title: OpenHLM: An Empirical Recipe for Whole-Body Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.summary_en: OpenHLM studies whole-body humanoid VLA interfaces and heterogeneous training data.
papers.summary_zh: OpenHLM研究全身人形VLA的接口设计与异构训练数据。

papers.title: Macro-Operator Generation and Predicate Selection for TAMP Operator Learning
papers.summary_en: The method discovers reusable symbolic macro-operators and selects predicates for task-and-motion planning.
papers.summary_zh: 方法发现可复用符号宏算子，并为任务运动规划选择谓词。

papers.title: 2AM: Grounding Agent-Side Memory as Guidance for Steerable Action Models in Long-Horizon Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Agent-side memory provides structured guidance to an action model for long-horizon manipulation.
papers.summary_zh: Agent侧记忆为动作模型提供结构化指导以执行长时序操作。

papers.title: Spotter: Let the Embodied Model Lead, and the VLM Reflect for It
papers.summary_en: Spotter lets the embodied policy act while a VLM selectively reflects and repairs.
papers.summary_zh: Spotter让具身策略主导执行，由VLM选择性反思和修复。

papers.title: Dynamics-Aware Meta-Imitation for Generalization to Unseen Robotic Manipulation

papers.title: Pose accuracy is not grasp reliability: residual pose posteriors improve simulated robotic grasp planning

papers.title: WasserMan: Benchmark for Underwater Manipulation Policy Learning
papers.summary_en: WasserMan evaluates underwater contact manipulation with paired physical diagnostics rather than completion alone.

papers.title: ReWorld: Multi-Dimensional Reward Modeling for Embodied Video Generation
papers.summary_en: ReWorld trains a multidimensional reward model and post-trains embodied video generators with a flow-based PPO proxy.

papers.title: Any-ttach: Quick End-effector Swapping Enables Manipulation Dexterity with Simplicity

papers.title: Tactile MNIST: Benchmarking Active Tactile Perception

papers.title: OmniGuide: Universal Spatial Guidance Fields for Enhancing Generalist Robot Policies

papers.title: GazeVLA: Learning Human Intention for Robotic Manipulation
papers.summary_en: GazeVLA transfers human intention through a gaze-derived intermediate representation and intention-action reasoning.

papers.title: Towards General Continuous Memory for Vision-Language Models

papers.title: Functional Critics for Off-Policy Actor-Critic: From Stability to Exploration
papers.summary_en: Policy-conditioned functional critics connect off-policy stability with policy-space exploration.

papers.title: InTAct: Interval-based Task Activation Consolidation for Continual Learning

papers.title: Adaptive Auto-Harness: Sustained Self-Improvement for Agentic System Deployment on Open-Ended Task Streams

papers.title: Harnessing Agent Skills: Architectural Patterns and a Reference Architecture for Skill-Mediated LLM Agents

papers.title: Interpreting at Write Time: A Policy Ablation for Multi-Goal Agent Memory
papers.summary_en: A controlled memory-write study compares neutral summaries, fused multi-goal summaries, and separate per-goal stores.

papers.title: Cycle WAM: Coupling Action and Video through Cycle Consistency

papers.title: PolicyIK: High-Precision Inverse Kinematics for Robot Arms with Reinforcement Learning

papers.summary_zh: 目标条件强化学习学习精确到达和持续保持。

papers.summary_zh: DynaFLIP对齐图像变化、语言和三维流，预训练与动作相关的视觉表征。

papers.title: FlatLands: Indoor floormap completion from a single egocentric view
papers.summary_en: FlatLands benchmarks uncertainty-aware completion of metric indoor floor maps from a single egocentric observation.
papers.summary_zh: FlatLands评测从单个第一视角观测补全具有不确定性的公制室内地面地图。

papers.title: Controlling Action-Head Co-Adaptation to VLM Representation Anisotropy
papers.summary_en: AdaIE reweights VLM channels using online action-head sensitivity estimates without adding trainable parameters; statistics freeze at inference.
papers.summary_zh: AdaIE 根据在线估计的动作头敏感度重加权 VLM 通道，不增加可训练参数，推理时冻结统计量。

papers.title: Human-to-Robot Transfer via Bridging Representation and Action Space in VLAs
papers.summary_en: H2RB combines geometry-grounded observations with shared action latents and separate human/robot decoders for unpaired transfer.
papers.summary_zh: H2RB 结合几何约束观测、共享动作潜变量和独立人机解码器，实现非配对迁移。

papers.title: DexCanvas: Bridging Human Demonstrations and Robot Learning for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.summary_en: DexCanvas adds a unified policy for reconstructing force-annotated human demonstrations, unseen-object evaluation, contact-aware downstream learning and simulated robot-hand retargeting.
papers.summary_zh: DexCanvas新增统一策略以重建带力标注的人类示范，并加入未见物体评测、接触感知下游学习和仿真机器人手重定向。

papers.title: Can Astra Solve RoboMME without Breaking the Bank?
papers.summary_en: Three-tier planner, VLA executor and small completion monitor reduce expensive planning calls.
papers.summary_zh: 三级结构以高层规划器、VLA执行器及小型完成监测器减少昂贵规划调用。

papers.title: Robocasa-Mem: Benchmarking Environment and Process Memory in Long-Horizon Mobile Manipulation
papers.summary_en: RoboCasa-Mem separates environment and process memory with constraints conditioned on the robot's own earlier behavior.
papers.summary_zh: RoboCasa-Mem区分环境记忆和过程记忆，并依据机器人自身先前行为生成后续约束。

papers.title: Compounding Physical RSI: Turning Execution Failure into Inherited Capability
papers.summary_en: Stage diagnosis, behavior-regularized offline RL and weight-space retention aim to compound inherited capabilities.
papers.summary_zh: 以阶段诊断、行为正则离线RL及权重空间保留机制累积能力。

papers.title: PyRUA-REAL: Robot Exploration and Adaptive Learning through RSI in the Real World
papers.summary_en: PyRUA-REAL converts physical exploration into persistent experience and reusable executable skills.
papers.summary_zh: PyRUA-REAL将真实物理探索转化为持久经验与可复用可执行技能。

papers.title: Rethinking Self-Repair in Code-as-Policy Agents: What Drives Retry Success?
papers.summary_en: Self-repair audit compares failure templates with resampling, mismatched feedback and fixed guidance.
papers.summary_zh: 自修复审计比较失败模板、重新采样、错配反馈及固定指导。

papers.title: STARE: Scene Text-Aware multimodal Retrieval for Everyday objects
papers.summary_en: STARE combines scene text and visual semantics for free-form object retrieval, using crosslingual visual prompts and named-entity-aware reranking.
papers.summary_zh: STARE结合场景文字与视觉语义进行自由文本物体检索，采用跨语言视觉提示和命名实体重排序。

papers.title: EviSeek: An Evidence-Centric Agentic Framework for Embodied Active Information Seeking
papers.summary_en: EviSeek explicitly converts questions into evidence-acquisition needs, then coordinates observation-conditioned actions and selective evidence retention without training.
papers.summary_zh: EviSeek将问题显式转为证据获取需求，再协调基于观察的动作与选择性证据保留，无需训练。

papers.title: Time-to-Goal: Learned Temporal Metrics for Long-Horizon Planning with JEPA World Models
papers.summary_en: Time-to-Goal learns temporal ranking costs while freezing a JEPA encoder and predictor.
papers.summary_zh: Time-to-Goal冻结JEPA编码器与预测器，仅学习具有时间顺序的规划距离。

papers.title: Open-HumanScale: An Open Recipe for Scaling Human and Robot Experience for Embodied Foundation Models
papers.summary_en: Open-HumanScale studies human-video scaling with a curated 50,000-hour corpus, then extends HumanWAM from human-only pretraining to joint human–robot and visual-goal conditioning.
papers.summary_zh: Open-HumanScale以整理后的5万小时人类第一视角语料研究数据规模效应，并将HumanWAM从纯人类预训练扩展到人机联合训练和视觉目标条件控制。

papers.title: ReactWorld: Structuring Interaction Responses for Embodied Video Generation
papers.summary_en: ReactWorld predicts structured interaction-response fields and feeds motion-dependent feature increments and temporal-attention biases into embodied video generation.
papers.summary_zh: ReactWorld预测结构化交互响应场，将运动相关特征增量和时间注意力偏置反馈到具身视频生成。

papers.title: TouchéWorld tech report : Towards Online Unified Camera--Hand Exploration in Generative Worlds
papers.summary_en: TouchéWorld unifies camera navigation and hand gestures in generative worlds using aligned camera–hand data, hand-conditioning adapters, causal adaptation and few-step distillation; introduces TouchéBench.
papers.summary_zh: TouchéWorld通过相机与手部对齐数据、手部条件适配器、因果适配及少步蒸馏，将相机漫游与手势交互统一到生成世界，并提出TouchéBench。

papers.title: Motion-guided Contrastive Regularization For Latent World Models
papers.summary_en: Motion-guided contrastive regularization counters static-background collapse in JEPA world models by contrasting within-episode transitions with optical-flow-derived soft targets.
papers.summary_zh: 该方法通过同一轨迹内的转移对比和光流软目标，缓解JEPA世界模型只保留静态背景、丢失控制相关变化的问题。

papers.title: SurgTransfer: Multi-Step Latent Action Modeling for Action Transfer in Surgical World Model
papers.summary_en: SurgTransfer learns multi-step, context-invariant latent actions from surgical video to transfer procedural motion between scenes without requiring kinematic action labels.
papers.summary_zh: SurgTransfer从手术视频学习多步、上下文不变的隐动作，以在场景间迁移操作运动，无需运动学动作标签。

papers.title: Interactive World Simulation with Cosmos for Physical AI
papers.summary_en: Cosmos adapts world foundation models to streaming action-conditioned simulation and simulator-state-conditioned rendering for bimanual manipulation, camera exploration and autonomous-driving views.
papers.summary_zh: Cosmos将世界基础模型适配为流式动作条件仿真，以及外部仿真状态条件渲染，覆盖双臂操作、相机探索与自动驾驶视角。

papers.title: $A^3$-VLA: Automatic Perception-Guided Attention Alignment for Robot Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Interaction-derived regions supervise VLA attention allocation and language-region alignment.
papers.summary_zh: 从交互变化产生区域监督，约束VLA注意力及语言区域对齐。

papers.title: From Pixels to Actions - Towards Native Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.summary_en: NEO-VLA uses lightweight patch tokenization and joint vision-language computation, exposing multiple backbone depths to a flow-matching action expert instead of a fixed visual encoder endpoint.
papers.summary_zh: NEO-VLA采用轻量图像分块和视觉语言联合计算，让流匹配动作专家读取多个深度的特征，而非固定视觉编码器的最终输出。

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning Enables Scaling Generalist Robot Policy Improvement
papers.summary_en: Systematically compares direct policy adaptation, critic-guided action refinement and critic-guided policy extraction for multi-task online improvement of generalist robot policies.
papers.summary_zh: 系统比较直接策略适配、评论器引导的动作筛选和策略提取，以研究通用机器人策略的多任务在线改进。

papers.title: Correct Robots Before They Make Mistakes: Proactive Human-in-the-Loop Intervention via Preference Learning
papers.summary_en: PHIL previews future trajectories in XR and turns proactive corrections into preference pairs.
papers.summary_zh: PHIL在XR中预览未来轨迹，将提前干预转化为偏好训练对。

papers.title: Online Adaptation to Latent Physical Properties for Learning from Demonstration
papers.summary_en: Updates physical-property latents online from prediction errors while policy and dynamics weights remain fixed.
papers.summary_zh: 根据预测误差在线更新物理属性隐变量，策略及动力学模型权重保持不变。

papers.title: TwinBridge: Digital Twin-Driven Policy and Reward Transfer for Real-World Reinforcement Learning in Laboratory Robotics
papers.summary_en: Digital twins supply policy initialization and dense visual reward supervision for real online refinement.
papers.summary_zh: 数字孪生提供策略初始化和稠密视觉奖励监督，用于真机在线优化。

papers.title: Diversity-Aware Experience Replay via Statistical Leverage Scores
papers.summary_en: Leverage-based replay emphasizes unusual experience; goal-relative windows recover relational rarity.
papers.summary_zh: 基于统计杠杆值的回放突出稀有经验，目标相对轨迹窗口识别关系型稀有事件。

papers.title: Ctrl-F: Force as an Interface for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Force commands connect motion imitation to high-level object interaction.
papers.summary_zh: 以显式接触力指令连接动作模仿与物体交互。

papers.title: ELA: End-to-End Latent Action Policy Learning from Video Demonstrations
papers.summary_en: Jointly optimizes latent actions, policy and decoder using videos plus a few labeled robot demonstrations.
papers.summary_zh: 联合优化隐动作、策略与解码器，结合视频及少量带动作标注的机器人示范。

papers.title: Learning Object-Centric Motion Priors from Human for Robotic Dexterous Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Human hand-object future predictions become object-centric RL rewards across robot hands.
papers.summary_zh: 利用人手与物体未来状态预测构造物体中心RL奖励，并跨机器人手迁移。

papers.title: Which Physical Tactile Cues Matter for Contact-Rich Imitation Learning? A Controlled Real-Robot Study
papers.summary_en: Controlled ablation separates tactile RGB, geometry and marker-flow cues under matched data and policy.
papers.summary_zh: 在相同数据及策略下分离触觉RGB、几何和标记流信号。

papers.title: Dexterous Robotic Hands in the Foundation-Model Era: A Full-Stack Survey of Hardware, Data, Cross-Embodiment Transfer, Learning, and Evaluation
papers.summary_en: Full-stack narrative survey links dexterous hardware, human data, transfer, foundation models and evaluation.
papers.summary_zh: 全栈叙述性综述串联灵巧手硬件、人类数据、迁移、基础模型及评测。

papers.title: GRASP: Gradient-Guided Sampling for Contact-Rich Physics-Based Motion Retargeting
papers.summary_en: GRASP recovers local gradients from archived simulator rollouts for contact-rich retargeting without differentiable physics.
papers.summary_zh: GRASP从存档仿真轨迹估计局部梯度，实现无需可微仿真的接触密集重定向。

papers.title: Perceptive Humanoid Motion from Simulation
papers.summary_en: HALO synthesizes vision-language-motion data in1000 procedural homes and composes humanoid skills.
papers.summary_zh: HALO在1000个程序生成住宅中合成视觉—语言—动作数据，并组合人形技能。

papers.title: MESA: An Evaluation Framework for Compositional, Semantic, and Spatial Generalization in Robotics
papers.summary_en: Five controlled suites isolate spatial, instance, category and subtask generalization; includes bimanual BiMESA.
papers.summary_zh: 五组受控评测分离空间、实例、类别和子任务泛化，并包含双臂BiMESA。

papers.title: RACE: Calibrated Cumulative Scoring for Rollout-Free Robot Policy Checkpoint Selection
papers.summary_en: RACE ranks checkpoints from held-out successful trajectories using calibrated deviations and cumulative products.
papers.summary_zh: RACE利用成功验证轨迹、校准动作偏差及累乘评分选择检查点。

papers.title: Detecting Silent Action-Interface Mismatch with Calibrated Relational World Models
papers.summary_en: Calibrated state-action-effect models detect semantic action-interface errors offline.
papers.summary_zh: 校准状态—动作—效果模型，离线检测动作接口语义错误。

papers.title: Where Is VLA Inference Time Spent? Bottlenecks and Optimization Interactions Across GPUs
papers.summary_en: VLA-Triage measures interaction among seven inference optimization families across models and GPUs.
papers.summary_zh: VLA-Triage研究七类推理优化在不同模型与GPU上的相互影响。

papers.title: VABAR: A Variational Automation Benchmark for Agentic Robotics
papers.summary_en: VABAR targets repeatable task variation with a skill library and programmatic references.
papers.summary_zh: VABAR通过技能库及程序参考解评测可重复的任务变体。

papers.title: BEAKER: An Expert-Curated Benchmark for Embodied Brains in Self-Driving Chemical Laboratories
papers.summary_en: BEAKER diagnoses execution-relevant perception and reasoning for self-driving chemical laboratories through expert-authored image/video questions, including affordance localization and feasible trajectory judgments.
papers.summary_zh: BEAKER通过专家编写的图像及视频问题，诊断自动化化学实验室中与执行相关的感知推理能力，包括可操作区域定位和可行轨迹判断。

papers.title: FLAG: Flow Policy MaxEnt-RL by Latent Augmented Guidance
papers.summary_en: FLAG trains flow policies for maximum-entropy reinforcement learning with localized importance sampling; v2 adds empirical checks of its theoretical approximations and narrows performance claims.
papers.summary_zh: FLAG用局部重要性采样训练最大熵强化学习流策略；v2新增理论近似的实证检查并收窄性能主张。

papers.title: Warp: Structured Output-Space Adaptation for Frozen Robot Policies
papers.summary_en: Structured monotone spline adaptation of frozen robot policies; revision adds matched SplineRes controls and diagnostics separating parameterization benefits from nonlinear action reshaping.
papers.summary_zh: 用结构化单调样条适配冻结机器人策略；本次新增匹配SplineRes对照和诊断，区分参数化优势与非线性动作重塑。

papers.title: MARLIN: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Guided by Language-Based Inter-Robot Negotiation
papers.summary_en: MARLIN combines MAPPO with language-based pairwise robot negotiation. This revision matters chiefly as a method and claim correction, rather than a new performance result.
papers.summary_zh: MARLIN 将 MAPPO 与机器人之间基于语言的两两协商结合。本次修订主要是方法表述和结论范围的更正，并非新增性能结果。

papers.title: Learning Soft Robotic Dynamics with Active Exploration
papers.summary_en: SoftAE learns reusable soft-robot dynamics through uncertainty-driven optimistic exploration. The revision extends its evidence to soft–rigid contact and adds stronger exploration/control comparisons; the original multi-platform and 2 mm hardware reaching results are not new.
papers.summary_zh: SoftAE 通过不确定性驱动的乐观探索学习可复用的软体机器人动力学。本次修订新增软体与刚体接触实验及更强的探索/控制对照；原有跨平台验证和真机 2 毫米到达误差并非新增结果。

papers.title: Back to the Familiar Future: Failure Recovery for VLA Policies via Pre-Imagined Milestone Selection
papers.summary_en: B2FF recovers a frozen foresight VLA by selecting a pre-imagined visual milestone. The revision adds direct tests of imagined futures versus observed past states and recovery-specific VLA fine-tuning, plus meaningful evaluation corrections.
papers.summary_zh: B2FF 通过选择预先想象的视觉里程碑帮助冻结的前瞻型 VLA 恢复执行。本次修订直接比较想象未来与历史观测作为恢复目标，并加入恢复数据微调 VLA 的对照及重要评估更正。

papers.title: Bridging the Morphology Gap: Adapting VLA Models to Dexterous Manipulation via Intent-Conditioned Fine-Tuning
papers.summary_en: InDex couples synchronized end-effector/grasp-intent prediction with a diffusion hand decoder. The retitled revision adds held-out object-instance evaluation and materially revises training-budget and timing-test reporting.
papers.summary_zh: InDex 将同步的末端执行器/抓取意图预测与扩散式灵巧手解码器结合。更名后的修订版新增留出物体实例评估，并实质性修改训练预算及意图时序干预的试验说明。

papers.title: Test-Time Improvement of VLA Policies via Selected Diffusion Noise for Spurious-Robust Action Smoothing
papers.summary_en: SDN selects frozen-VLA action samples using object-grounding and jerk criteria. The revision adds mechanism-focused evidence: task-irrelevant masking controls, attribution-based ranking analysis, BYOVLA comparisons, and negative-set construction tests.
papers.summary_zh: SDN 根据物体视觉定位和加加速度指标，从冻结 VLA 的动作样本中选择输出。本次修订新增针对机制的证据：任务无关遮罩对照、基于归因的排序分析、BYOVLA 比较及负样本集构建测试。

papers.title: AutoDex: An Automated Real-World System for Dexterous Grasping Data Collection
papers.summary_en: AutoDex executes and labels generated dexterous grasps and resets objects. This revision replaces the earlier throughput-only story with explicit human-attention, wall-time and data-quality accounting, acknowledging intermittent intervention.
papers.summary_zh: AutoDex 执行并标注生成的灵巧抓取，同时重置物体。本次修订将原先单纯强调吞吐量的叙述改为明确区分人工注意时间、总耗时及数据质量，并承认仍需间歇性干预。

papers.title: Reverse to Advance: Teleoperation-Cost Effective Hard Policy Learning from Reversed Easy Tasks
papers.summary_en: Auto-E2H learns difficult manipulation from reversed easy-task trajectories and iterative filtered rollouts. New appendices substantially strengthen auditing: critic controls, training-seed variability, operator cost and explicit failure boundaries under directional contact resistance.
papers.summary_zh: Auto-E2H 利用简单任务的反向轨迹及迭代过滤数据学习困难操作。新增附录显著增强可审查性，覆盖价值评估器对照、训练种子波动、人工成本及方向相关接触阻力下的失效边界。

papers.title: AcroRL: Learning Aggressive Quadrotor Inversion using Bidirectional Thrust
papers.summary_en: AcroRL learns reference modulation for bidirectional-thrust quadrotor inversions; v2 expands simulation reliability reporting and clarifies the small hardware evidence base.
papers.summary_zh: AcroRL学习双向推力四旋翼翻转的参考轨迹调制；v2扩展仿真可靠性报告并明确小规模真机证据。

papers.title: Provably Safe, Yet Scalable Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary_en: PS2-RL combines a learned backup policy with a differentiable control-invariant projection; v2 adds multi-constraint robot-control tests and audits safety versus performance roles.
papers.summary_zh: PS2-RL结合学习备用策略与可微控制不变投影；v2新增多约束机器人控制测试并分析安全与性能来源。

papers.title: EvoWorld: Evolving Panoramic World Generation with Explicit 3D Memory
papers.summary_en: Panoramic world generation with explicit 3D memory; this entry records evidence and wording corrections, not a new method.
papers.summary_zh: 以显式三维记忆生成全景世界；本条记录证据和表述纠正，不视为新方法。

papers.title: MessyNav: Zero-Shot Navigation via Manipulation in Messy Environments
papers.summary_en: MessyNav inserts explicit affordance reasoning before VLM planning to move or avoid obstacles.
papers.summary_zh: MessyNav 在 VLM 规划前显式判断可供性，决定移动或绕开障碍物。

papers.title: Fast and Reliable Open-Vocabulary Object Search with Absence Detection from Robot Memory
papers.summary_en: Retrieval followed by visual verification lets robot memory abstain when an object is absent.
papers.summary_zh: 先检索再视觉验证，使机器人记忆能在目标不存在时拒绝返回误匹配。

papers.title: HITCH: Teaching a Vision-Language Model to Operate a Humanoid through a Whole-Body Harness
papers.summary_en: HITCH exposes 3D point perception and whole-body command interfaces, then teaches a VLM reusable humanoid operation.
papers.summary_zh: HITCH 提供三维点感知及全身指令接口，再训练 VLM 学习可复用的人形操作能力。

papers.title: RoboARCade: Benchmarking Agentic Robot Control
papers.summary_en: RoboARCade isolates direct multimodal-agent robot control, memory and in-context improvement across 22 long-horizon tasks and 3 embodiments.
papers.summary_zh: RoboARCade以22项长时程任务、三形态检验多模态代理直接控制、记忆与上下文改进。

papers.title: Learning the Task or Learning the Verifier? Rethinking Criteria Exposure in Embodied Self-Improvement
papers.summary_en: An embodied self-improvement audit separates learning the instructed task from overfitting exposed success verifiers.
papers.summary_zh: 具身自我改进审计区分学习任务与过拟合暴露的成功判据。

papers.title: OopsieRecover: Learning Transferable VLA Corrections from Semantic Interventions
papers.summary_en: OopsieRecover abduces semantic spatial correction programs from interventions and steers a frozen VLA only when needed.
papers.summary_zh: OopsieRecover从干预中溯因学习语义空间纠正程序，仅在需要时引导冻结VLA。

papers.title: Embodied RAG++: Retrieval-Augmented Generation From What Exists to What Works in Embodied Scenes
papers.summary_en: Embodied RAG++ joins product manuals with scene instances and deterministic robot-object feasibility.
papers.summary_zh: Embodied RAG++ 将产品手册、场景对象实例与确定性的机器人可达性推理结合。

papers.title: Binding Paraphrased Instructions to Encountered Objects in sLLM Agents under Partial Observability
papers.summary_en: ALFWorld-Para diagnoses instruction-synonym grounding failures; training-free BINDIntent probabilistically binds phrases to encountered object labels under partial observability.
papers.summary_zh: ALFWorld-Para诊断指令同义词带来的落地失误；无需训练的BINDIntent在部分可观测环境中，将表达概率性绑定到已见物体标签。

papers.title: Which Objects Stay? Learning Hierarchical Persistence Beliefs for Lifelong Open-Vocabulary Object Maps
papers.summary_en: HiPer retrieves appearance/geometry-based persistence priors, updates object-specific Bayesian survival beliefs, and transfers those beliefs when objects relocate.
papers.summary_zh: HiPer按外观和几何检索持久性先验，在线更新物体级贝叶斯存续信念，并在物体换位时迁移已学信念。

papers.title: Generate-then-Rank: Learning Symbolic Goal Interpretation for Embodied Agents
papers.summary_en: Generate-then-Rank fine-tunes symbolic goal generation and learns output preferences from candidate errors.
papers.summary_zh: Generate-then-Rank微调符号目标生成，再从候选错误学习输出偏好。

papers.title: WAM-Sim0.1: World Anchored Memory Meets Online RL for Consistent and Realistic Driving Simulation
papers.summary_en: WAM-Sim anchors driving-video generation with pose-aligned road structure, geolocated background memory and write-once object identity tokens, then applies online flow-matching RL.
papers.summary_zh: WAM-Sim以姿态对齐道路结构、地理定位背景记忆和一次写入的物体身份令牌约束驾驶视频生成，再用在线流匹配强化学习后训练。

papers.title: Time-Indexed Skill Success Models for Latency-Aware Skill Selection and Timing in Dynamic Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Time-indexed competence predicts success conditional on delayed skill launch and plans both skill and timing.
papers.summary_zh: 按延迟启动时间建模技能成功率，同时规划技能及其启动时机。

papers.title: Leave It Better Than Found: Value-Guided Cooperation in Sequential Tasks
papers.summary_en: Robots share value functions and a KNN uncertainty filter for ad hoc sequential cooperation.
papers.summary_zh: 机器人共享价值函数并使用 KNN 不确定性过滤，实现无需共同训练的顺序协作。

papers.title: RM-VLM: From Natural-Language Task Descriptions to Vision-Grounded Reward Machines
papers.summary_en: RM-VLM decomposes language tasks into reward-machine propositions, grounds them with a frozen VLM, and tracks a probabilistic automaton state for non-Markovian reward learning.
papers.summary_zh: RM-VLM把语言任务分解为奖励机命题，用冻结VLM落地视觉状态，并以概率自动机状态处理非马尔可夫奖励学习。

papers.title: SCALE: Real-Time Latent Communication for Cyber-Physical Agents
papers.summary_en: SCALE reuses latent tokens across messages and schedules communication under bandwidth/deadline limits.
papers.summary_zh: SCALE复用消息间潜在token，并在带宽与截止时间约束下调度通信。

papers.title: Spatial-UMI-Dream: Scaling World Action Models with Metric Geometry for UMI Manipulation
papers.summary_en: A 5B RGB-D world-action model makes metric geometry explicit in wrist-camera UMI demonstrations.
papers.summary_zh: 以 5B RGB-D 世界动作模型显式学习腕部相机 UMI 示范中的度量几何。

papers.title: La-JEPA: Compact Robot Policies with Latent World Modeling
papers.summary_en: La-JEPA trains compact action/world transformers from scratch over pretrained V-JEPA2.1 features, skipping future prediction at inference.
papers.summary_zh: La-JEPA 在预训练V-JEPA2.1特征上从头训练紧凑动作/世界Transformer，推理时省去未来预测。

papers.title: GPWM: Modeling the World as 3D Particle Motion
papers.summary_en: GPWM predicts particles and rigid-body motion in 3D and searches latent noise for contact-rich plans.
papers.summary_zh: GPWM在三维空间预测粒子与刚体运动，并搜索潜在噪声生成接触密集计划。

papers.title: MAC-v2: Long-horizon model-based value expansion from pixels
papers.summary_en: MAC-v2 combines reconstruction-free latent dynamics and action chunking for long-horizon model-based value expansion in pixel-based offline RL.
papers.summary_zh: MAC-v2结合无需图像重建的潜在动力学与动作分块，在像素输入的离线强化学习中进行长时域模型价值扩展。

papers.title: Seeing Beyond the Next Step: World-Model-Guided Human-Like Navigation in Multi-Agent Scenes
papers.summary_en: Social/semantic world models rank actions during training, then distill foresight into a single-pass navigation policy.
papers.summary_zh: 训练时由社交与语义世界模型评价动作，将前瞻能力蒸馏进单次前向导航策略。

papers.title: Learning Robotic World Models with Semantic and Visual Feedback
papers.summary_en: RoboImagine post-trains visual robot world models using diverse candidate futures and semantic/visual preferences.
papers.summary_zh: RoboImagine 通过多样候选未来和语义、视觉偏好反馈后训练机器人视觉世界模型。

papers.title: Structure from Collision via Hypothesis-Space Reasoning
papers.summary_en: Hypothesis-space Structure from Collision infers hidden cavities from deformation, then refines with differentiable particle simulation.
papers.summary_zh: 假设空间碰撞结构推断通过变形识别隐藏空腔，再用可微粒子仿真优化。

papers.title: GuidedWAM: Training-Free Energy Guidance for World Action Models in Autonomous Driving
papers.summary_en: GuidedWAM applies differentiable objective energies to clean-action estimates during frozen driving-WAM sampling.
papers.summary_zh: GuidedWAM在冻结驾驶WAM采样时，对干净动作估计施加可微目标能量。

papers.title: STEP: Spatiotemporal Training with Explicit Prediction for Perceptive Humanoid Locomotion
papers.summary_en: STEP couples cross-modal masked prediction with action-conditioned latent next-state prediction for humanoid control.
papers.summary_zh: STEP 结合跨模态掩码预测及动作条件潜在下一状态预测，训练人形控制表示。

papers.title: Reinforcing End-to-End Autonomous Driving Safety via Negative-Aware Planning in a Unified World-Action Model
papers.summary_en: NegWAM post-trains driving WAMs against dangerous near-expert trajectories; auxiliary safety branch is discarded at inference.
papers.summary_zh: NegWAM 用接近专家但危险的轨迹后训练驾驶 WAM；推理时丢弃辅助安全分支。

papers.title: VisionSIM: Beyond Idealized Sensors - A Multi-Modal Simulator for Robot Perception
papers.summary_en: VisionSIM simulates raw measurement processes and modality-specific failures for conventional and emerging sensors.
papers.summary_zh: VisionSIM模拟传统及新型传感器的原始测量过程与特定失效模式。

papers.title: VFlash: Fast, Accurate Visual Planning via Flash Primitive Decoding
papers.summary_en: VFlash jointly decodes structured visual primitives instead of serial coordinate tokens.
papers.summary_zh: VFlash整体解码结构化视觉原语，而非逐坐标token生成。

papers.title: SLA: Scaling Spatial-Language-Action Model via Continual Pre-training
papers.summary_en: SLA maintains 3D teacher alignment through continual pretraining and downstream adaptation of pi0.5.
papers.summary_zh: SLA在pi0.5持续预训练及下游适配期间维持三维教师对齐。

papers.title: T3R: Training-Free Two-Stage Token Refinement Towards Efficient and Robust VLA Models
papers.summary_en: T3R combines segmentation-based token pruning with saliency-based attention steering, without VLA retraining.
papers.summary_zh: T3R无需重训VLA，结合分割token裁剪与显著性注意力引导。

papers.title: Failure Prediction and Classification in Vision-Language-Action Models Via Calibrated Latent Probing
papers.summary_en: VLA-Tug uses latent probes and statistical calibration for early failure alarms and failure-mode classification.
papers.summary_zh: VLA-Tug以潜在探针及统计校准实现早期失败告警与失败类型识别。

papers.title: Efficient Diffusion Policy Fine Tuning with Latent Noise Representation Bridging
papers.summary_en: LARBRID bridges action-space and initial-noise value representations to adapt diffusion/flow policies.
papers.summary_zh: LARBRID 对齐动作空间与初始噪声空间价值表示，以适配扩散或流策略。

papers.title: Kinematic Hypothesis Context: Embodiment-Conditioned Learned Video Coding for Bandwidth-Limited Robot Policy Uplinks
papers.summary_en: Robot kinematics provide free shared context for learned video compression on policy uplinks.
papers.summary_zh: 利用机器人运动学提供通信双方共享、无需额外码率的上下文，压缩策略上行视频。

papers.title: Concertina: Embodying Manipulation and Cognition in One Diffusion Vision-Language Model
papers.summary_en: Concertina embeds continuous action tokens and physical-coordinate supervision directly in a shared diffusion VLM, without a separate action-generation transformer.
papers.summary_zh: Concertina将连续动作令牌和物理坐标监督直接放入共享扩散VLM，不另设动作生成Transformer。

papers.title: AffectiveVLA: Safe and Intent-Aware VLA Control for Human-Humanoid Social Interaction
papers.summary_en: AffectiveVLA adds intent gating, compliance profiles and a voice-triggered stop to humanoid social touch.
papers.summary_zh: AffectiveVLA 为人形社交接触加入意图门控、柔顺控制和语音停止。

papers.title: Aligning Policy Encoders with a Shape Teacher
papers.summary_en: Shape-teacher alignment transfers Point-MAE object geometry into image-policy features during training only.
papers.summary_zh: 训练时以Point-MAE物体几何指导图像策略编码器，部署仍只用图像。

papers.title: Semantics-to-Contact: A Stagewise Framework for Robust Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.summary_en: S2C separates VLM semantic localization from force-aware human-in-the-loop residual RL.
papers.summary_zh: S2C 将 VLM 语义定位与带力反馈的人在环残差强化学习分开。

papers.title: TactileLab: Sim-to-Real Dexterous Robot Manipulation with Efficient Shear-Sensitive Tactile Simulation
papers.summary_en: TactileLab approximates shear with rigid-body tactile flow and translates real sensor images into simulation representations.
papers.summary_zh: TactileLab 以刚体仿真的触觉流近似剪切，并将真实传感图像转换到仿真表示。

papers.title: An Empirical Study of Reinforcement Learning for Keypoint Positioning of Deformable Linear Objects
papers.summary_en: Studies RL training stacks, relative keypoint observations and randomization for deformable linear objects.
papers.summary_zh: 研究可变形线状物操作的强化学习训练栈、相对关键点观测与随机化。

papers.title: PhySA: Decoupling Aesthetic and Physical Rewards for Humanoid Locomotion
papers.summary_en: PhySA separates VLM aesthetic rewards from state-based physical smoothness corrections.
papers.summary_zh: PhySA 将 VLM 审美奖励与基于状态的物理平滑度修正分离。

papers.title: Terrain-Indexed Motion Priors and Geometric Support for Extreme Humanoid Parkour
papers.summary_en: Progressive imitation first acquires parkour skills, then relaxes motion priors to adapt hand/knee support.
papers.summary_zh: 渐进模仿先学习跑酷技能，再减弱动作先验以适配手膝支撑。

papers.title: Detecting Silent Faults at the Environment-Trainer Boundary in Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary_en: A step ledger checks the environment-trainer wire protocol to expose silent RL data faults.
papers.summary_zh: 逐步账本检查环境—训练器通信协议，以发现静默强化学习数据故障。

papers.title: SHORE: Stability-Hybrid On-Policy Reinforcement Learning for Online Bin Packing
papers.summary_en: SHORE combines learned stability probability with stability-conditioned return for online bin packing.
papers.summary_zh: SHORE将稳定性概率与稳定条件收益结合，用于在线装箱。

papers.title: Latent RL Priors for Data-Efficient Dexterous Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Latent RL Prior freezes a privileged-RL action decoder and learns an image-to-latent interface from demonstrations.
papers.summary_zh: Latent RL Prior冻结由特权状态强化学习得来的动作解码器，再由示范学习图像到潜在接口。

papers.title: MOMASPLAT: Dynamic Novel-View Demonstration Augmentation for Mobile Manipulation
papers.summary_en: MOMASPLAT reconstructs static scene and moving object separately to augment full demonstrations from unseen base poses.
papers.summary_zh: MOMASPLAT分别重建静态场景与运动物体，从新底座位姿合成完整示范。

papers.title: VREgo: Consumer VR Headsets for Learning Robot Manipulation from Egocentric Demonstrations
papers.summary_en: Consumer VR head/hand tracking supplies egocentric demonstrations for simulated manipulation.
papers.summary_zh: 用消费级 VR 头手跟踪采集第一视角示范，训练仿真操作策略。

papers.title: GraspBench: Execution-Aware Cross-Robot Evaluation of 6-DoF Grasp Generation in MuJoCo
papers.summary_en: GraspBench evaluates complete grasp proposal-to-execution pipelines across robot embodiments.
papers.summary_zh: GraspBench 跨机器人形态评估从抓取候选到实际执行的完整流程。

papers.title: Social Humanoid: Socially Responsive Human-Humanoid Interaction
papers.summary_en: Social Humanoid models human-robot motion jointly and uses contact-preserving adaptive retargeting.
papers.summary_zh: Social Humanoid联合建模人—机器人运动，并以保接触的自适应重定向构建数据。

papers.title: Closed-Loop Physics-Based Manipulation Evaluation at a Commodity Price: What 4.4 L4 GPU hours at $3.50 Buys You
papers.summary_en: A commodity-GPU harness makes repeated closed-loop manipulation evaluation inexpensive.
papers.summary_zh: 以低成本 GPU 工具支持重复闭环操作评估。

papers.title: How do Transformers Perform Low-Level Control In-Context?
papers.summary_en: A GPT-2-style controller learns to stabilize unknown nonlinear systems using passive, unforced trajectories as context rather than known system parameters.
papers.summary_zh: GPT-2式控制器以无外力轨迹作为上下文，在未知非线性系统参数下学习稳定控制。

papers.title: IMUDINO: Self-distilled Foundation Model for Inertial Sensing
papers.summary_en: IMUDINO adapts DINO-style self-distillation to inertial signals with motion-preserving augmentations and frequency-aware positions, transferring wearable-IMU features to robot odometry.
papers.summary_zh: IMUDINO以保留运动语义的增强和频率感知位置编码，将DINO式自蒸馏用于惯性信号，并将可穿戴IMU特征迁移到机器人里程计。

papers.title: ArtCrafter: Feed-Forward Generation of Articulated 3D Object with Analytic Joint Derivation
papers.summary_en: ArtCrafter jointly generates paired rest/open articulated meshes from two images, then derives URDF joint parameters analytically from paired rigid transformations.
papers.summary_zh: ArtCrafter从静止与开启状态的两张图联合生成配对可动网格，再根据刚体变换解析计算URDF关节参数。

papers.title: PlayGen2: Learning Real-Time Playable Worlds with Explicit 3D State
papers.summary_en: PlayGen2 separates explicit 3D world-state prediction from rendering, using persistent occupancy and identity-indexed entity memory instead of feeding generated images back into dynamics.
papers.summary_zh: PlayGen2把显式3D世界状态预测与渲染分离，以持久占据网格和带身份索引的实体记忆建模，不将生成图像回灌动力学。

papers.title: Interactive Visual Gym: Evaluating Visual Interaction Models with Simulated Users in Interactive Worlds
papers.summary_en: Interactive Visual Gym evaluates assistants in closed-loop simulated cooking, household and mobile-interface tasks, with persona-conditioned users and controlled errors.
papers.summary_zh: Interactive Visual Gym在烹饪、家居和手机界面仿真中闭环评估助手，引入带个性的模拟用户及可控失误。

papers.title: EmboTeam: Asymmetric State Grounding for Heterogeneous Multi-Robot Collaboration
papers.summary_en: LLM-generated state expectations, PDDL verification and parallel behavior trees coordinate heterogeneous robot skills through reactive checks and synchronization.
papers.summary_zh: LLM生成状态预期，经PDDL验证后用并行行为树、反应式检查和同步协调异构机器人技能。

papers.title: When Vision Overrides Language: Evaluating and Mitigating Counterfactual Failures in VLAs
papers.summary_en: LIBERO-CF tests alternative instructions in identical scenes; CAG contrasts conditioned and unconditioned actions to reduce visual shortcuts.
papers.summary_zh: LIBERO-CF在相同场景下测试替代指令；CAG对比有语言与无语言分支动作以抑制视觉捷径。

papers.title: RoboCurate: Harnessing Diversity with Action-Verified Synthetic Data for Robot Learning
papers.summary_en: Uses simulator replay to verify motion agreement between generated videos and inverse-dynamics action labels before training robot policies.
papers.summary_zh: 将逆动力学模型预测的动作在仿真器中回放，验证其与生成视频的运动一致性，再用于策略训练。

papers.title: VTAM: Efficient Visuo-Tactile World-Action Models for Contact-Rich Manipulation without Tactile Pretraining
papers.summary_en: Adapts a shared video backbone to visual/tactile prediction and trains an action expert with an optical-flow-derived contact proxy; inference does not fully denoise videos.
papers.summary_zh: 以共享视频主干学习视觉与触觉预测，并用光流接触代理量监督动作专家；推理无需完整视频去噪。

papers.title: WorldAct: Activating Monolithic 3D Worlds into Interactive-Ready Object-Centric Scenes
papers.summary_en: A VLM agent decomposes monolithic generated 3DGS worlds into manipulable objects, restores backgrounds and reconstructs collision geometry for editable simulation scenes.
papers.summary_zh: VLM agent 将单体生成 3DGS 世界分解成可操纵物体、补全背景并重建碰撞几何。

papers.title: EgoKit: Towards Unified Low-Cost Egocentric Data Collection with Heterogeneous Devices
papers.summary_en: Unified egocentric and wrist-video/tracking collection across six heterogeneous host devices; XR headsets additionally provide head pose and 26-joint hand tracking.
papers.summary_zh: 跨六类设备统一自我视角与腕部视频/追踪采集工具；XR 提供头部和 26-joint 手追踪。

papers.title: Event-Grounded Sparse Autoencoders for Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.summary_en: Event-grounded SAE feature ranking and residual-preserving interventions probe causal influences on closed-loop VLA behavior.
papers.summary_zh: 事件对齐SAE特征排序与保留残差的干预，用于研究VLA闭环行为的因果敏感性。

papers.title: ActQuant: Sub-4-bit Action-Guided Backbone Weight-Only Quantization for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.summary_en: Action-aware sub-4-bit VLA weight-only quantization: HSIC allocates tensor bit widths, Action-Mixed Fisher optimizes scales, and OmniModel.cpp supports native deployment.
papers.summary_zh: 动作感知低比特 VLA 量化：HSIC 分配张量位宽，Action-Mixed Fisher 优化缩放，并以 OmniModel.cpp 部署。

papers.title: CoDiMAD: Diffusion-Based Privileged Distillation for Communication-Free Multi-Robot Coordination
papers.summary_en: CoDiMAD distills privileged MAPPO into local-history diffusion policies to avoid averaging distinct cooperative action modes.
papers.summary_zh: CoDiMAD把特权MAPPO蒸馏为局部历史条件的扩散策略，避免对不同协作动作模式取平均。

papers.title: VIGOR: Zero-Shot Visual Generalization via Latent-Space Consistency in Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary_en: VIGOR combines weak-to-strong augmentation, dynamics consistency and encoder stabilization for zero-shot visual generalization of latent world-model RL.
papers.summary_zh: VIGOR结合弱强增强、动力学一致性与编码器稳定化，改善潜在世界模型强化学习的零样本视觉泛化。

papers.title: Evo-DexBench: Benchmarking Generalization across Related Tasks for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Core-Gen functional-transfer benchmark with 30 tasks, six families and 1,248 simulated dexterous-hand multimodal demonstrations including tactile signals.
papers.summary_zh: Core-Gen 功能相关任务迁移基准：30 tasks、6 families、1,248 模拟双灵巧手多模态示范与 tactile。

papers.title: OpenTac: An Open Ecosystem for Customizable, Scalable, and Transferable 3D Tactile Sensing
papers.summary_en: Adds a new high-dynamic-range (HDR) tactile-readout method and hardware experiments. Saturated taxels are reread at lower amplifier gains within the same frame. The real-robot manipulation policy results and previous cross-sensor transfer experiments are unchanged.
papers.summary_zh: 新增高动态范围（HDR）触觉读出方法与硬件实验：在同一帧内以更低的放大器增益重读饱和触觉单元。原有真实机器人操作策略结果与跨传感器迁移实验不变。

papers.title: SONIC-K1: Porting a Universal Humanoid Motion Tracker to a Small Humanoid on a Single GPU
papers.summary_en: Adds a real-robot-oriented post-training recipe and matched old/new checkpoint evaluations. Starting from the v0.1 tracker, v1.0 adds 4,000 training iterations with deployment torque limits, 0–40 ms actuation delay, gain randomization, and a near-torque-limit penalty; the new run takes about 9.2 GPU-hours on one RTX PRO 6000.
papers.summary_zh: 新增面向真实机器人的后训练配方，以及同设置下新旧检查点对比。从 v0.1 跟踪器出发，v1.0 再训练 4,000 轮，加入部署扭矩限制、0–40 ms 执行延迟、增益随机化及接近扭矩上限的惩罚；单张 RTX PRO 6000 约需 9.2 GPU 小时。

papers.title: PhysTrace: Interpretable Temporal Evaluation of Physical Consistency in Video Generative Models
papers.summary_en: PhysTrace is a training-free, history-conditioned expectation–observation alignment evaluator for physical consistency in video, using an MLLM, video–text embeddings and selectively retained state descriptions. The revision adds a controlled reference-guided reconstruction experiment for video backbones relevant to world–action models.
papers.summary_zh: PhysTrace使用MLLM、视频—文本嵌入及选择性保留的状态描述，通过历史条件下的预期—观测对齐评估视频物理一致性，无需训练。此次修订新增面向世界—动作模型相关视频骨干的受控参考引导重建实验。

papers.title: ZipDrift: Generating Multimodal Short-Horizon MPC Costs with One-Step Drifting Models
papers.summary_en: This record documents a correction or status change, not a new research advance.
papers.summary_zh: 此记录为内容或状态修正，不代表新的研究进展。

papers.title: World Models as Adversaries: Multi-Agent Self-Play Fine-Tuning for Robust Motion Planning
papers.summary_en: A role-conditioned adversarial traffic world model trains sparse cooperative attacks, then remains frozen for regret-CVaR ego-planner adaptation.
papers.summary_zh: 角色条件对抗交通世界模型学习稀疏协作攻击，再冻结用于regret-CVaR自车规划器适应。

papers.title: WoVR: World Models as Reliable Simulators for Post-Training VLA Policies with RL
papers.summary_en: This record documents a correction or status change, not a new research advance.
papers.summary_zh: 此记录为内容或状态修正，不代表新的研究进展。

papers.title: AnyDexRT: Calibration-Efficient Dexterous Hand Retargeting with Few-Shot Human Guidance
papers.summary_en: Few-shot human anchor guidance, self-supervised fingertip correspondence and a contact classifier support retargeting for multiple dexterous robot hands.
papers.summary_zh: 少量人体引导 anchor、自监督手指对应与接触分类器用于多种灵巧手遥操作。

papers.title: DenseReward: Dense Reward Learning via Failure Synthesis for Robotic Manipulation
papers.summary_en: DenseReward learns visual-language progress scores from 27k success/failure trajectories and supplements sparse completion rewards for robot policy RL.
papers.summary_zh: DenseReward用2.7万成功/失败轨迹学习视觉语言进度评分，为机器人策略强化学习补充稀疏完成奖励。

papers.title: PFM-HR: Pose Flow Matching for Humanoid Robots
papers.summary_en: PFM-HR learns a frozen unordered-pose flow-matching prior and uses its Jacobian response to shape humanoid tracking rewards.
papers.summary_zh: PFM-HR从无序姿态学习冻结流匹配先验，用雅可比响应塑造人形机器人跟踪奖励。

papers.title: On Agentic Manipulation Policies
papers.summary_en: AMP1 lets a generalist model write and execute robot-control code, with optional persistent cross-episode memory.
papers.summary_zh: AMP1 让通用模型编写并执行机器人控制代码，并可加入跨回合持久记忆。

papers.title: Meituan-Robotics-0: A Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Desktop Manipulation
papers.summary_en: MR0 combines three-stage VLA training, Rollback correction data and event-driven persistent memory for task resumption.
papers.summary_zh: MR0 结合三阶段 VLA 训练、Rollback 人工纠错数据和事件驱动持久记忆，以支持任务恢复。

papers.title: PRISM: Primitive Routing via In-context Skill Mixing for Retentive VLA Adaptation
papers.summary_en: Stores skills in frozen low-rank action adapters and composes them with chunk-level routing.
papers.summary_zh: 将技能保存为冻结低秩动作适配器，用逐动作块路由组合技能。

papers.title: VICTR: Value-Informed In-Context Learning for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.summary_en: Retrieves demonstration context by estimated task progress rather than visual similarity alone.
papers.summary_zh: 按示范条件下估计的任务进度检索动作上下文，而非只依赖视觉相似性。

papers.title: A Controlled Study of Models, Skills, Feedback, and Curriculum in Agentic Robotics
papers.summary_en: Controlled experiments vary model capability, skill priors, feedback and curriculum in coding-agent robot self-improvement.
papers.summary_zh: 控制比较模型能力、技能先验、反馈结构与课程，分析代码智能体如何通过物理交互改进机器人策略。

papers.title: Flex-RSI: Benchmarking Recursive Self-Improvement of Frontier Agents
papers.summary_en: Benchmarks agents that revise both solutions and their own harness, including prompts, tools, memory and control loops, under fixed budgets.
papers.summary_zh: 在固定预算下评测智能体对解法及自身框架的改进，包含提示、工具、记忆与控制循环。

papers.title: DobotTrack: Target-Grounded Vision-Language-Action Learning for Embodied Person Tracking
papers.summary_en: Mask/box grounding and Q-identity history compression preserve target identity and spatial cues in compact historical tokens.
papers.summary_zh: 通过目标掩码/边界框监督及Q-identity历史压缩，在紧凑历史token中保留身份与空间线索。

papers.title: Can LLMs Debug Robots by Editing Their Weights?
papers.summary_en: An LLM edits 65 token-embedding rows using budgeted simulation feedback, without gradients or new demonstrations.
papers.summary_zh: LLM利用有限仿真反馈直接编辑65个词嵌入行，无梯度更新或新增示范，修复指令词汇绑定。

papers.title: Computer-Use Agents Are Embodied Generalists
papers.summary_en: Wraps embodied tasks in software interfaces so a single computer-use agent can act through screenshots, clicks and keystrokes.
papers.summary_zh: 将具身任务封装为软件界面，使同一计算机使用智能体通过截图、点击与按键操作。

papers.title: HiMEM: Hippocampus-Inspired Memory Consolidation, Pruning, and Composition for Vision-Language-Action Models in 3D Scenes
papers.summary_en: HiMEM consolidates robot execution episodes into semantic manipulation rules, prunes redundant episodic memories, and composes retrieved memories to condition VLA action generation.
papers.summary_zh: HiMEM 将机器人执行经历整合为语义操作规则，剪除冗余情节记忆，并组合检索到的记忆以辅助 VLA 动作生成。

papers.title: Encoding Memory in World Models with Test-Time Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary_en: TT-MBRL stores episode-specific memory by updating world-model parameters at test time rather than relying only on recurrent/contextual state. It improves several model architectures on Memory Maze 2D and 3D while maintaining strong DeepMind Control/Atari 100k performance. The approach is relevant to long-horizon navigation and partially observed embodied tasks.
papers.summary_zh: TT-MBRL 在测试时更新世界模型参数以编码当前回合的记忆，而不只依赖循环状态或上下文。论文在二维和三维 Memory Maze 中提升了多种架构的表现，同时在 DeepMind Control 与 Atari 100k 上保持较强性能。该方向与长时程导航和部分可观测具身任务相关。

papers.title: DexDICE: Reconciling Safety and Performance via Dual-Expert Offline Imitation Learning
papers.summary_en: DexDICE separates safety-compliant and performance-oriented demonstrations, combining distribution correction with safe-support constraints. It evaluates 38 re-curated DSRL tasks and a physical mobile robot trained from teleoperation. The robot reached its goal in all 10 trials with no observed safety violation. This makes it directly relevant to learning robot policies from imperfect demonstrations.
papers.summary_zh: DexDICE 将遵守安全规范但可能次优的示范与高性能但可能不安全的示范分开建模，通过分布校正和安全支持集约束学习策略。论文评估了重新整理的 38 个 DSRL 任务及使用遥操作数据训练的实体移动机器人；实体实验 10 次均到达目标，未观察到安全违规。适用于混合质量示范下的机器人策略学习。

papers.title: Probably Safe Sim-to-Real Transfer with Lifetime Validity
papers.summary_en: Dejavu certifies each simulation-trained policy before deployment using only trajectories from a safe deployed baseline. Per-decision importance sampling, betting confidence sequences and summable failure budgets aim to preserve statistical validity across an unbounded sequence of promotions. The method targets repeated robot-policy upgrades rather than one-off sim-to-real transfer.
papers.summary_zh: Dejavu 仅利用已部署安全基线策略收集的轨迹，在候选仿真策略部署前进行认证。方法结合逐决策重要性采样、投注置信序列及可求和失败概率预算，使无界次数的策略升级仍具有统计有效性。其目标是持续更新策略过程中的安全认证，而不只是一次性的仿真到现实迁移。

papers.title: TouchAnnotator: Multi-Source Tactile Supervision with Privileged-View Distillation
papers.summary_en: TouchAnnotator unifies glove pressure, geometry-derived human contact and robot fingertip deformation into a canonical bimanual tactile field. A teacher uses ego and wrist views during training, while inference needs ego video and estimated hand pose. Evaluation includes EgoTouch, zero-shot FPHA and 860 synchronized glove recordings; reported gains on measured recordings are 5.38 points in temporal accuracy and 5.02 points in Volumetric IoU.
papers.summary_zh: TouchAnnotator 将手套压力、几何推导的人手接触和机器人指尖形变统一为双手触觉场。训练教师使用第一视角与腕部视角，推理仅需第一视角视频和估计手姿。评估涵盖 EgoTouch、零样本 FPHA 及 860 段同步手套记录；在实测记录上，时间准确率和体积 IoU 分别提升 5.38 和 5.02 个百分点。

papers.title: Safe Reinforcement Learning via Probabilistic Option Shielding
papers.summary_en: Probabilistic Option Shielding learns an option-safety critic from one-step logic-shielding signals, estimating whether temporally extended behaviors finish safely. On LogiCity navigation variants it improves training safety while retaining task performance, providing a long-horizon safety mechanism without a complete environment model.
papers.summary_zh: 概率选项屏蔽从单步逻辑屏蔽信号学习选项安全评价器，预测具有时间延展的行为能否安全完成。在 LogiCity 导航变体中，它改善训练安全性并保持任务表现，为缺乏完整环境模型的系统提供长时程安全机制。

papers.title: BEV3SR: Evidence-Aware 3D Spatial Reasoning from Video
papers.summary_en: BEV3SR converts RGB-D video with camera parameters into a metric BEV scene memory. It formalizes each question, computes geometric answers explicitly or retrieves object-consistent views for a VLM. Under a 16-frame budget with Qwen3-VL-8B, SQA3D exact match rises 51.6%→62.6%, and ScanQA exact match 27.8%→30.6%. It offers a potentially useful spatial reasoning layer for embodied systems.
papers.summary_zh: BEV3SR 将带相机参数的 RGB-D 视频转为具有度量信息的 BEV 场景记忆，再形式化问题，通过显式几何计算作答或为 VLM 检索对象一致的视角。采用 Qwen3-VL-8B 和 16 帧预算时，SQA3D 精确匹配率由 51.6% 升至 62.6%，ScanQA 由 27.8% 升至 30.6%。可作为具身系统的空间推理组件。

papers.title: MDF++: Visuo-Tactile World Action Model with End-to-end Representation Learning
papers.summary_en: A visuo-tactile world-action model learns control-relevant representations end-to-end using cross-modal multitask training.
papers.summary_zh: 视觉触觉世界动作模型端到端学习控制表征，以多任务跨模态训练避免特征坍塌。

papers.title: FATHOM: World-Model-Guided Diffusion Action-Trajectory Selection for Sparse-Marker AUV Tracking
papers.summary_en: A recurrent world model fuses markers, inertial sensing, and action history to rank diffusion-generated thruster trajectories.
papers.summary_zh: 循环状态空间模型融合稀疏光标记、惯性与动作历史，再用预测结果选择扩散生成的推进器轨迹。

papers.title: Toward the Era of Agentic Embodied Intelligence
papers.summary_en: A2-MEAS combines correction codes, execution history, MetaBrain guidance and an A2-WLA policy with latent world modeling.
papers.summary_zh: A2-MEAS 结合纠错代码、执行历史、MetaBrain 引导，以及包含潜在世界模型的 A2-WLA 策略。

papers.title: ODEAction: From Predicting Chunks to Evolving Actions
papers.summary_en: Learns an action-transition field and integrates an ODE to evolve actions continuously instead of predicting separate chunks.
papers.summary_zh: 通过学习动作转移场并积分ODE，连续递推动作，替代独立动作块预测。

papers.title: Q-OIL: Optimistic Exploration in Learning from Human Interventions
papers.summary_en: Uses progress-aware human intervention modeling and decoupled critics to treat imperfect corrections as exploration guidance.
papers.summary_zh: 利用进度感知的人工干预模型和解耦 critic，将不完美纠错用作探索指引。

papers.title: CS-Pi: Constraint-Satisfying Flow Policy Sampling
papers.summary_en: Draw-project-renoise sampling adds deployment-time constraints without retraining the underlying flow policy.
papers.summary_zh: 通过采样、投影、重新加噪，在不重训流策略的情况下施加部署时约束。

papers.title: ActPrune: Action-Grounded Visual Token Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.summary_en: Uses previous-action geometry to prune fixed-view and wrist-view tokens before visual encoding.
papers.summary_zh: 利用上一动作块的几何先验，在视觉编码前针对固定与腕部相机分别剪枝。

papers.title: VLA Handover: Failure-Prediction-Based Switching from On-Robot to Server VLA Models
papers.summary_en: Runs a small onboard VLA and requests a server VLA when failure is predicted.
papers.summary_zh: 机器人先运行小型 VLA，仅在预测失败时切换到服务器大模型。

papers.title: Horizon-Coupled Obstacle Guidance for Relative-Action Diffusion Policies
papers.summary_en: Rolls relative actions into trajectories and propagates SDF obstacle responses across the denoising horizon without retraining.
papers.summary_zh: 将相对动作累积成轨迹，并在去噪时把SDF障碍反馈传播到整个动作时域，无需重训。

papers.title: SURE:Spatiotemporal Uncertainty Representation for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Learning
papers.summary_en: A probabilistic action decoder and Soft-DTW alignment make VLA supervision tolerant of spatial and timing variation.
papers.summary_zh: 以概率动作解码器和 Soft-DTW 对齐建模空间与时间不确定性，降低对示范姿态及速度的敏感性。

papers.title: Localizing and Editing the Goal Representation of a Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.summary_en: Studies OpenVLA failures on negated instructions and localizes editable goal representations.
papers.summary_zh: 分析 OpenVLA 对否定指令的失效，并定位可编辑的目标表征。

papers.title: HomeLoop: A Simulation Framework and Benchmark for Robot-IoT Coordination in Everyday Domestic Assistance and Safety
papers.summary_en: Benchmarks domestic robot-IoT decisions under ambiguous alerts, residents, and evolving hazards in Isaac Sim.
papers.summary_zh: 用 Isaac Sim 模拟家庭机器人、物联网、居民和动态危险，评估有歧义警报下的决策。

papers.title: Auditing Grasp Feasibility Predictors with Planner-Verified Counterfactuals
papers.summary_en: Planner-relabelled obstacle insertions test whether grasp-feasibility predictors actually use collision geometry.
papers.summary_zh: 保持抓取姿态不变、向接近路径加入障碍，并由规划器重标可行性，审计预测器是否真正理解碰撞几何。

papers.title: Goodhart in the Planner: Sampling-Based Control Exploits Rewards Learned from Human Preferences
papers.summary_en: Studies how stronger search can exploit preference-model errors despite high held-out label accuracy; proposes calibrated regularization.
papers.summary_zh: 研究更强搜索如何在偏好标签准确率较高时仍利用奖励模型误差，并提出校准正则化。

papers.title: Seeing What Matters: Benchmarking Task-Conditioned Actionable Spatial Belief for Manipulation
papers.summary_en: Tests whether an agent acquires the views needed by its current manipulation command rather than merely describing a scene.
papers.summary_zh: 评测智能体能否取得当前操作指令所需视角，而不只是描述场景。

papers.title: ForPC: Force-Aware Whole-Body Control for Precise Humanoid Cart Pushing
papers.summary_en: Two-stage RL infers force and state latents from onboard observations and coordinates whole-body residual control.
papers.summary_zh: 两阶段强化学习从机载观测推断力与状态潜变量，协调全身残差控制。

papers.title: It Takes Two to Tangram: Multi-Agent Object Centric Reinforcement Learning for Assembly
papers.summary_en: Treats assembly pieces as agents and learns graph-based coordinated planar motions.
papers.summary_zh: 将每个拼块视为协作智能体，用图网络策略协调平面装配。
